source.text: Ἤκουσαν δὲ οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ οἱ ὄντες κατὰ τὴν Ἰουδαίαν ὅτι καὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἐδέξαντο τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Heard now the apostles and the brothers the [ones] being throughout the Judea that also the Gentiles received the word of the God.

en.L: Now the apostles and the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who were throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
en.B: Word reached the apostles and the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} all over Judea that even the Gentiles had accepted the word of God.
en.R: The apostles and the other believers in Judea heard news about Peter. They heard that people who were not Jews had also accepted God's message.

es.L: Oyeron entonces los apóstoles y los hermanos que estaban por toda Judea que también los gentiles habían recibido la palabra de Dios.
es.B: Los apóstoles y los hermanos de toda Judea se enteraron de que también los gentiles habían aceptado la palabra de Dios.
es.R: Los apóstoles y los demás creyentes de Judea oyeron noticias acerca de Pedro. Supieron que también personas que no eran judías habían aceptado el mensaje de Dios.

fr.L: Or les apôtres et les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui étaient dans toute la Judée apprirent que les nations aussi avaient reçu la parole de Dieu.
fr.B: Les apôtres et les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} de toute la Judée apprirent que même les non-Juifs avaient accueilli la parole de Dieu.
fr.R: Les apôtres et les autres croyants de Judée ont reçu des nouvelles de Pierre. Ils ont appris que des gens qui n’étaient pas juifs avaient, eux aussi, accepté le message de Dieu.

sw.L: Basi mitume na ndugu waliokuwa katika Uyahudi yote walisikia kwamba watu wa mataifa nao walikuwa wamelipokea neno la Mungu.
sw.B: Mitume na ndugu waliokuwa kote katika Uyahudi walipata habari kwamba hata watu wa mataifa walikuwa wamelipokea neno la Mungu.
sw.R: Mitume na waumini wengine katika Uyahudi walisikia habari kuhusu Petro. Walisikia kwamba watu wasio Wayahudi nao walikuwa wameupokea ujumbe wa Mungu.

vi.L: Các sứ đồ và các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} ở khắp Giu-đê nghe tin rằng các dân ngoại cũng đã tiếp nhận lời Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Các sứ đồ và các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} ở khắp miền Giu-đê nghe tin rằng ngay cả các dân ngoại cũng đã tiếp nhận lời Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Các sứ đồ và các tín hữu khác ở miền Giu-đê nghe tin về Phi-e-rơ. Họ nghe rằng những người không phải Do Thái cũng đã tiếp nhận sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그런데 사도들과 온 유대에 있는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들이 이방 사람들도 하나님의 말씀을 받아들였다는 소식을 들었다.
ko.B: 사도들과 온 유대에 있는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 이방 사람들도 하나님의 말씀을 받아들였다는 소식이 들려왔다.
ko.R: 사도들과 유대에 있는 다른 믿는 사람들이 베드로에 관한 소식을 들었다. 유대인이 아닌 사람들도 하나님의 말씀을 받아들였다는 소식이었다.

decisions.choice: brothers: the believers, men and women
decisions.reason: Acts calls the believers brothers from 1:15 on. Nothing here limits the news to men.

decisions.choice: the Gentiles: people who were not Jews, here Cornelius and those gathered with him
decisions.reason: The news is about what happened in Caesarea in 10:24-48, where Gentiles heard Peter and received the Holy Spirit (10:45).

decisions.choice: received: welcomed and believed the message
decisions.reason: To receive the word is to accept it as true, as in 2:41 and 8:14.

decisions.choice: brothers and sisters, with "brothers" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word takes in all the believers, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: the other believers; people who were not Jews; God's message
alternatives: the brothers; the Gentiles; the word of God
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who the brothers and the Gentiles were and what the word of God is. It also says the news was about Peter, which the next verse makes clear.

decisions.choice: hermanos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "brothers and sisters" with "brothers" as the alternative. Spanish "hermanos" already takes in the sisters (meaning decision m1), so the setting has nothing to change; the same in verse 29.

decisions.choice: los gentiles (L, B); personas que no eran judías (R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet word for this book, recorded once in this chapter: "gentiles" names people who were not Jews (meaning decision m2); Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does. The same in verse 18.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Peter's account to the believers (11:5-17) in the passé composé at every level, as speech
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Acts: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read in school. Peter's retelling is speech, so it keeps the tenses of speech at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}
decisions.reason: As the English: the word takes in all the believers, men and women (m1); French "frères et sœurs" is the inclusive default and "frères" the traditional alternative. The words that follow ("qui étaient") agree with both.

decisions.choice: ndugu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "brothers and sisters" with "brothers" as the alternative. "Ndugu" already means brothers and sisters alike (meaning decision m1), so the setting has nothing to change; the same in verse 29.

decisions.choice: watu wa mataifa (L, B); watu wasio Wayahudi (R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet words for this book, recorded once in this chapter: people who were not Jews (meaning decision m2). Plain "mataifa" would read as whole nations; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does. The same in verse 18.

decisions.choice: {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 (L, B); "이방 사람들" (L, B), "유대인이 아닌 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The brothers are the believers, men and women (meaning decision), with the settled span; Gentiles as settled at 4:27.

source.text: ὅτε δὲ ἀνέβη Πέτρος εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, διεκρίνοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς λέγοντες ὅτι Εἰσῆλθες πρὸς ἄνδρας ἀκροβυστίαν ἔχοντας καὶ συνέφαγες αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: When now went up Peter to Jerusalem, were taking issue with him those of [the] circumcision \v 3 saying that, You went in to men uncircumcision having and you ate with them.

en.L: And when Peter went up to Jerusalem, those of [the] circumcision took issue with him, \v 3 saying, "You went in to men having uncircumcision and ate with them!"
en.B: Once Peter was back in Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took him to task. \v 3 "You went in to men who are uncircumcised," they said, "and you sat down to eat with them!"
en.R: Later Peter went up to Jerusalem. There some Jewish believers argued with him. \v 3 They said, "You went into the home of men who are not circumcised, men who are not Jews. And you even ate with them!"

es.L: Y cuando subió Pedro a Jerusalén, discutían con él los de [la] circuncisión, \v 3 diciendo: «¡Entraste en [casa de] hombres incircuncisos y comiste con ellos!».
es.B: Cuando Pedro volvió a Jerusalén, los creyentes circuncidados le reprocharon lo que había hecho. \v 3 Le decían: «Entraste en casa de hombres que no están circuncidados, ¡y te sentaste a comer con ellos!».
es.R: Después Pedro subió a Jerusalén. Allí algunos creyentes judíos discutieron con él. \v 3 Le dijeron: «Entraste en la casa de hombres que no están circuncidados, hombres que no son judíos. ¡Y hasta comiste con ellos!».

fr.L: Et quand Pierre monta à Jérusalem, ceux de la circoncision le prirent à partie, \v 3 disant : « Tu es entré chez des hommes incirconcis et tu as mangé avec eux ! »
fr.B: Quand Pierre fut de retour à Jérusalem, les croyants circoncis lui firent des reproches. \v 3 « Tu es entré chez des hommes incirconcis, disaient-ils, et tu t’es mis à table avec eux ! »
fr.R: Plus tard, Pierre est monté à Jérusalem. Là, des croyants juifs se sont disputés avec lui. \v 3 Ils lui ont dit : « Tu es entré dans la maison d’hommes qui ne sont pas circoncis, des hommes qui ne sont pas juifs. Et tu as même mangé avec eux ! »

sw.L: Na Petro alipopanda kwenda Yerusalemu, wale wa tohara walibishana naye, \v 3 wakisema, "Uliingia kwa wanaume wasiotahiriwa, ukala pamoja nao!"
sw.B: Petro aliporudi Yerusalemu, waumini waliotahiriwa walimlaumu. \v 3 Walisema, "Uliingia nyumbani mwa watu wasiotahiriwa, ukaketi kula pamoja nao!"
sw.R: Baadaye Petro alipanda kwenda Yerusalemu. Huko baadhi ya waumini Wayahudi walibishana naye. \v 3 Walisema, "Uliingia nyumbani mwa watu wasiotahiriwa, watu wasio Wayahudi. Tena ulikula pamoja nao!"

vi.L: Khi Phi-e-rơ lên Giê-ru-sa-lem, những người thuộc giới cắt bì chỉ trích ông \v 3 rằng: "Ông đã vào nhà những người không cắt bì và ăn chung với họ!"
vi.B: Khi Phi-e-rơ trở lên Giê-ru-sa-lem, các tín hữu đã chịu cắt bì chỉ trích ông. \v 3 Họ nói: "Ông đã vào nhà những người không chịu cắt bì, lại còn ngồi ăn chung với họ!"
vi.R: Sau đó Phi-e-rơ lên Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ở đó có mấy tín hữu Do Thái tranh cãi với ông. \v 3 Họ nói: "Ông đã vào nhà những người không chịu cắt bì, là những người không phải Do Thái. Ông lại còn ăn chung với họ nữa!"

ko.L: 그런데 베드로가 예루살렘에 올라갔을 때에, 할례받은 사람들이 그를 비난하며 \v 3 말했다. "당신은 할례받지 않은 사람들에게 들어가서 그들과 함께 먹었습니다!"
ko.B: 베드로가 예루살렘으로 돌아오자, 할례받은 신자들이 그를 나무라며 \v 3 말했다. "당신은 할례받지 않은 사람들의 집에 들어가서 그들과 함께 음식을 먹었습니다!"
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 베드로는 예루살렘으로 올라갔다. 그곳에서 유대인 신자 몇 사람이 베드로에게 따졌다. \v 3 그들이 말했다. "당신은 할례를 받지 않은 사람들, 곧 유대인이 아닌 사람들의 집에 들어갔습니다. 그리고 그들과 함께 음식까지 먹었습니다!"

decisions.choice: those of the circumcision: the Jewish believers, who held that Jews should not share a table with Gentiles
alternatives: a party that wanted Gentiles circumcised
Jews who did not believe in Jesus
decisions.reason: In 10:45 the same phrase names the Jewish believers who came with Peter. Here it may mean all the Jewish believers in Jerusalem, or a group among them that pressed this point, as some did later (15:1, 15:5; Galatians 2:12).

decisions.choice: took issue with: argued against him, found fault
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to judge or to dispute. Luke uses the same verb in 11:12, where the Spirit tells Peter to go "making no distinction"; the people who now take issue are doing what Peter was told not to do.

decisions.choice: going into a Gentile's house and eating with him: something Jewish custom ruled out
decisions.reason: Peter himself said in 10:28 that it was not lawful for a Jew to associate with or visit a foreigner. Eating together showed full fellowship, and the food might not be clean under the law (Leviticus 11).

decisions.choice: men having uncircumcision: men who are not circumcised, that is, Gentiles
alternatives: a remark only about their bodies
decisions.reason: Circumcision was the sign of God's covenant with Abraham's family (Genesis 17:10-14), so "uncircumcised" means outside that people.

decisions.choice: the circumcised believers
decisions.reason: Balanced names the group as the meaning note reads it.

decisions.choice: men who are not circumcised, men who are not Jews
decisions.reason: Readable says what being uncircumcised meant for a Jew.

decisions.choice: des hommes incirconcis
decisions.reason: The Greek "having uncircumcision" is an idiom for "uncircumcised" (m4); a word-for-word French phrase would sound crude rather than literal, so Literal uses the adjective.

decisions.choice: The Jewish believers speak to Peter as "ông"; Peter answers with "tôi" and "chúng ta" (11:4-17)
decisions.reason: They are fellow believers finding fault with a leader of the church; "ông" keeps the respect due to him while they argue.

decisions.choice: "những người không cắt bì" (L) for "men having uncircumcision"
decisions.reason: Men who are not circumcised, that is, Gentiles (meaning decision); the Greek idiom is too blunt to copy word for word in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: the Jewish believers speak to Peter in 합쇼체 but call him "당신"; Peter answers them in 합쇼체 with "나" (11:5-17)
decisions.reason: They are fellow believers, so they speak formally, but they take him to task (meaning decision), and "당신" keeps the distance of a reproach, as hostile speakers address Jesus in the Korean Matthew 21:15. "할례받은 사람들" (L), "할례받은 신자들" (B), "유대인 신자" (R) for "those of the circumcision".

vi.L: Phi-e-rơ bắt đầu trình bày cho họ theo thứ tự mà nói:
vi.B: Phi-e-rơ bèn giải thích từng điều cho họ, từ đầu đến cuối.
vi.R: Vì vậy Phi-e-rơ giải thích cho họ mọi việc đã xảy ra, theo thứ tự. Ông nói:

ko.L: 그러자 베드로가 처음부터 차례대로 그들에게 설명하며 말했다.
ko.B: 그래서 베드로는 처음부터 차근차근 그들에게 모든 일을 설명했다.
ko.R: 그래서 베드로는 그들에게 일어난 일을 차례대로 모두 설명했다. 그가 말했다.

decisions.choice: in order: one event after another, as it happened
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same word of his own orderly account (Luke 1:3). Peter retells the events in the order they took place, letting them make his case.

decisions.choice: having begun: he started from the beginning of the story
decisions.reason: The participle can simply mark the start of his speech, but with "in order" it suggests he started at the beginning.

decisions.choice: a full stop, with the speech opening in the next sentence
decisions.reason: Balanced ends the sentence here and lets Peter's words begin with the next one.

source.text: Ἐγὼ ἤμην ἐν πόλει Ἰόππῃ προσευχόμενος καὶ εἶδον ἐν ἐκστάσει ὅραμα, καταβαῖνον σκεῦός τι ὡς ὀθόνην μεγάλην τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς καθιεμένην ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἦλθεν ἄχρι ἐμοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: I was in [the] city Joppa praying and I saw in a trance a vision, descending a certain vessel like a sheet great by four corners being let down out of the heaven, and it came as far as me.

en.L: "I was in [the] city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain vessel coming down like a great sheet, being let down by four corners out of heaven, and it came as far as me.
en.B: "I was in the town of Joppa at prayer, and in a trance I had a vision. An object like a huge sheet, held at its four corners, was being lowered out of heaven, and it came all the way to me.
en.R: "I was in the town of Joppa, and I was praying. Then God showed me a vision, like a dream while I was awake. I saw something like a large sheet coming down from the sky. It was being let down by its four corners, and it came right down to where I was.

es.L: «Yo estaba en [la] ciudad de Jope orando, y en un trance vi una visión: un objeto que bajaba, como una gran sábana, descolgada del cielo por sus cuatro extremos, y llegó hasta mí.
es.B: «Yo estaba orando en la ciudad de Jope y, en un trance, tuve una visión. Algo parecido a una enorme sábana, sostenida por sus cuatro extremos, iba bajando del cielo, y llegó hasta donde yo estaba.
es.R: «Yo estaba en la ciudad de Jope, orando. Entonces Dios me mostró una visión, como un sueño estando despierto. Vi algo como una sábana grande que bajaba del cielo. La iban bajando sostenida de sus cuatro puntas, y llegó hasta donde yo estaba.

fr.L: « J’étais dans la ville de Joppé en prière, et j’ai vu dans une extase une vision : un certain objet qui descendait, comme une grande toile descendue du ciel par quatre coins, et il est venu jusqu’à moi.
fr.B: « J’étais en prière dans la ville de Joppé, et dans une extase j’ai eu une vision. Un objet semblable à une immense toile, tenu par ses quatre coins, descendait du ciel, et il est arrivé jusqu’à moi.
fr.R: « J’étais dans la ville de Joppé, et je priais. Alors Dieu m’a montré une vision, comme un rêve, mais j’étais éveillé. J’ai vu quelque chose comme une grande toile qui descendait du ciel. On la descendait par ses quatre coins, et elle est arrivée tout près de moi.

sw.L: "Mimi nilikuwa katika mji wa Yafa nikiomba, na katika mzubao niliona maono: kitu fulani kikishuka kama shuka kubwa, kikiteremshwa kwa pembe zake nne kutoka mbinguni, nacho kikafika hadi kwangu.
sw.B: "Nilikuwa katika mji wa Yafa nikiomba, nikazama katika mzubao, nikaona maono. Kitu kama shuka kubwa, kilichoshikwa kwa pembe zake nne, kilikuwa kikiteremshwa kutoka mbinguni, nacho kikanifikia kabisa.
sw.R: "Nilikuwa katika mji wa Yafa, nikiomba. Kisha Mungu akanionyesha maono, kama ndoto nikiwa macho. Niliona kitu kama shuka kubwa kikishuka kutoka angani. Kilikuwa kikiteremshwa kwa pembe zake nne, nacho kikashuka mpaka mahali nilipokuwa.

vi.L: "Tôi đang cầu nguyện tại thành Giốp-bê, và trong khi xuất thần tôi thấy một khải tượng: một vật giống như tấm khăn lớn buộc bốn góc, từ trời thả xuống và đến tận chỗ tôi.
vi.B: "Tôi đang cầu nguyện tại thành Giốp-bê, và trong khi xuất thần tôi thấy một khải tượng. Có vật gì giống như một tấm khăn lớn được nắm bốn góc, từ trời thả xuống và đến tận chỗ tôi.
vi.R: "Tôi đang ở thị trấn Giốp-bê, và tôi đang cầu nguyện. Bấy giờ Đức Chúa Trời cho tôi thấy một khải tượng, như một giấc mơ trong khi tôi còn thức. Tôi thấy có vật gì giống như một tấm khăn lớn từ trời thả xuống. Tấm khăn được nắm bốn góc và thả xuống ngay chỗ tôi đang ở.

ko.L: "내가 욥바 성에서 기도하고 있었는데, 황홀경 가운데 환상을 보았습니다. 큰 보자기 같은 어떤 그릇이 네 귀퉁이가 매여 하늘에서 내려와 내게까지 왔습니다.
ko.B: "내가 욥바 성에서 기도하고 있을 때에, 황홀경에 빠져 환상을 보았습니다. 큰 보자기 같은 것이 네 귀퉁이가 매달린 채 하늘에서 내려와 바로 내 앞에까지 왔습니다.
ko.R: "나는 욥바라는 마을에서 기도하고 있었습니다. 그때 하나님께서 나에게 환상을 보여 주셨습니다. 깨어 있는데 꿈을 꾸는 것 같았습니다. 나는 큰 보자기처럼 생긴 것이 하늘에서 내려오는 것을 보았습니다. 그것은 네 귀퉁이가 매달린 채 내려와서 바로 내가 있는 곳까지 왔습니다.

decisions.choice: a trance: a state in which God showed him something, his mind taken out of its ordinary state
decisions.reason: The word means being out of one's usual state of mind. In 10:10 it came on Peter while he was hungry and waiting for food; he was awake (10:9).

decisions.choice: vessel: an object, here something like a sheet
alternatives: a container such as a jar or a basket
decisions.reason: The word is general: a thing, a jar, a piece of equipment. The sheet held by its corners is a picture of what he saw.

decisions.choice: heaven: the sky above, and God's dwelling
decisions.reason: The same word means both. The sheet comes from God, and in 11:10 it is taken back up into heaven.

decisions.choice: God showed me a vision, like a dream while I was awake
alternatives: in a trance I saw a vision
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a trance and a vision were. It says that God showed it, which the voice in 11:7-9 makes clear.

decisions.choice: the sky
decisions.reason: Readable says where Peter saw the sheet come from. The meaning note explains that the word also points to God.

decisions.choice: mzubao
decisions.reason: A state in which the mind is taken out of its ordinary state while God shows something (meaning decision m1). "Kuzimia" is to faint, and "njozi" is a dream or vision itself, which would repeat "maono"; "mzubao", a daze, keeps the two apart. A native reviewer may know a better word.

decisions.choice: the wording of Peter's vision as told in 10:10-16, with "나" for Peter
decisions.reason: Peter retells what Luke told in chapter 10, so the Korean repeats its words, now in Peter's 합쇼체.

source.text: εἰς ἣν ἀτενίσας κατενόουν καὶ εἶδον τὰ τετράποδα τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ θηρία καὶ τὰ ἑρπετὰ καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Into which having looked intently I was considering and I saw the four-footed [animals] of the earth and the wild beasts and the creeping things and the birds of the heaven.

en.L: Having looked into it intently, I was considering [it], and I saw the four-footed animals of the earth and the wild beasts and the creeping things and the birds of the sky.
en.B: As I stared into it and studied it closely, I saw animals of the earth that walk on four feet, wild animals, creatures that creep along the ground, and birds of the air.
en.R: I looked closely into it. Inside I saw all kinds of animals. There were animals with four feet, wild animals, animals that crawl on the ground, and birds.

es.L: Mirándola fijamente, la examinaba, y vi los animales de cuatro patas de la tierra, y las fieras, y los que se arrastran, y las aves del cielo.
es.B: Me quedé mirándola y la examiné con atención, y vi animales terrestres de cuatro patas, fieras, animales que se arrastran por el suelo y aves del cielo.
es.R: Miré con atención dentro de ella. Allí vi toda clase de animales. Había animales de cuatro patas, animales salvajes, animales que se arrastran por el suelo y aves.

fr.L: Y ayant fixé les yeux, je l’examinais, et j’ai vu les quadrupèdes de la terre, et les bêtes sauvages, et les bêtes rampantes, et les oiseaux du ciel.
fr.B: En la regardant fixement et en l’observant de près, j’ai vu les animaux de la terre qui marchent à quatre pattes, les bêtes sauvages, les petites bêtes qui se traînent sur le sol et les oiseaux du ciel.
fr.R: J’ai regardé dedans avec attention. J’y ai vu toutes sortes d’animaux. Il y avait des animaux à quatre pattes, des animaux sauvages, des animaux qui rampent sur le sol, et des oiseaux.

sw.L: Nikiikazia macho, nilikuwa nikiitafakari, nikaona wanyama wa miguu minne wa nchi, na wanyama wa porini, na wanyama watambaao, na ndege wa angani.
sw.B: Nilipoikazia macho na kuichunguza kwa makini, niliona wanyama wa nchi wenye miguu minne, wanyama wa porini, viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini, na ndege wa angani.
sw.R: Nilitazama ndani yake kwa makini. Ndani niliona wanyama wa kila aina. Kulikuwa na wanyama wenye miguu minne, wanyama wa porini, wanyama wanaotambaa ardhini, na ndege.

vi.L: Tôi chăm chú nhìn vào đó, xem xét, và thấy các loài thú bốn chân trên đất, các loài thú dữ, các loài bò sát và chim trời.
vi.B: Tôi chăm chú nhìn vào trong và xem xét kỹ, thì thấy những loài vật bốn chân trên đất, những thú hoang, những loài bò sát và chim trời.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn kỹ vào bên trong. Trong đó tôi thấy đủ loại thú vật. Có thú bốn chân, thú hoang, các loài bò sát trên đất, và các loài chim.

ko.L: 내가 그것을 똑바로 들여다보며 살펴보니, 땅의 네발짐승들과 들짐승들과 기어 다니는 것들과 하늘의 새들이 보였습니다.
ko.B: 내가 그 안을 뚫어지게 들여다보며 자세히 살펴보니, 땅의 네발짐승과 들짐승과 땅에 기어 다니는 것들과 하늘의 새들이 있었습니다.
ko.R: 나는 그 안을 자세히 들여다보았습니다. 그 안에는 온갖 짐승이 있었습니다. 네 발 달린 짐승과 들짐승과 땅에 기어 다니는 짐승과 새들이 있었습니다.

decisions.choice: every kind of animal: clean and unclean together
decisions.reason: The list follows the kinds of living things in Genesis 1:24-30 and 6:20. Peter's answer in 11:8 shows that animals the law of Moses called unclean were among them (Leviticus 11).

decisions.choice: I was considering: he kept looking, trying to understand
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense, after "having looked intently", pictures careful study.

decisions.choice: creatures that creep along the ground
decisions.reason: The word covers every small creature that moves along the ground, not only reptiles.

source.text: ἤκουσα δὲ καὶ φωνῆς λεγούσης μοι· Ἀναστάς, Πέτρε, θῦσον καὶ φάγε.

records.literal_gloss: I heard then also a voice saying to me, Having risen, Peter, kill and eat.

en.L: And I also heard a voice saying to me, 'Get up, Peter; kill and eat.'
en.B: Then I also heard a voice speaking to me: 'Up, Peter! Kill and eat.'
en.R: Then I heard a voice. It said to me, 'Get up, Peter. Kill some of these animals and eat them.'

es.L: Y oí también una voz que me decía: “Levántate, Pedro; mata y come”.
es.B: Entonces oí también una voz que me decía: “¡Arriba, Pedro! Mata y come”.
es.R: Entonces oí una voz que me dijo: “Levántate, Pedro. Mata algunos de estos animales y cómetelos”.

fr.L: Et j’ai entendu aussi une voix qui me disait : “Lève-toi, Pierre, tue et mange.”
fr.B: Puis j’ai entendu aussi une voix qui me disait : “Debout, Pierre ! Abats et mange.”
fr.R: Puis j’ai entendu une voix. Elle m’a dit : “Lève-toi, Pierre. Tue quelques-uns de ces animaux et mange-les.”

sw.L: Na nilisikia pia sauti ikiniambia, 'Inuka, Petro; chinja ule.'
sw.B: Kisha nikasikia pia sauti ikiniambia, 'Inuka, Petro! Chinja ule.'
sw.R: Kisha nikasikia sauti. Iliniambia, 'Inuka, Petro. Chinja baadhi ya wanyama hawa, uwale.'

vi.L: Tôi cũng nghe có tiếng phán với tôi: 'Hỡi Phi-e-rơ, hãy đứng dậy, giết mà ăn.'
vi.B: Rồi tôi nghe có tiếng nói với tôi: 'Phi-e-rơ, hãy đứng dậy, giết mà ăn!'
vi.R: Rồi tôi nghe có tiếng nói với tôi: 'Phi-e-rơ, hãy đứng dậy. Hãy giết mấy con vật này mà ăn.'

ko.L: 그리고 나는 나에게 '베드로야, 일어나서 잡아먹어라' 하고 말하는 음성도 들었습니다.
ko.B: 그리고 나에게 말하는 음성도 들었습니다. '베드로야, 일어나서 잡아먹어라.'
ko.R: 그때 어떤 목소리가 들렸습니다. 그 목소리가 나에게 말했습니다. '베드로야, 일어나라. 이 짐승들을 잡아서 먹어라.'

decisions.choice: kill: slaughter an animal for food
decisions.reason: The verb is used for sacrifice, but also for slaughtering an animal to eat (Luke 15:23). Here it goes with "eat".

decisions.choice: having risen: get up
decisions.reason: The participle is a command to stand up and act; Peter may have been kneeling to pray.

decisions.choice: some of these animals ... eat them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the voice told him to kill.

decisions.choice: Peter's retelling (11:5-17) is worded as the story of 10:9-48 wherever the Greek is the same
decisions.reason: Luke repeats the vision almost word for word, and the reader should see it; the Vietnamese repeats too.

source.text: εἶπον δέ· Μηδαμῶς, κύριε, ὅτι κοινὸν ἢ ἀκάθαρτον οὐδέποτε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ στόμα μου.

records.literal_gloss: I said however, By no means, Lord, for common or unclean never has entered into the mouth of me.

en.L: But I said, 'By no means, Lord, for nothing common or unclean has ever entered my mouth.'
en.B: But I answered, 'Certainly not, Lord! Nothing unholy or unclean has ever passed my lips.'
en.R: But I said, 'No, Lord! I could never do that! I have never eaten anything that our law calls unholy or unclean.'

es.L: Pero dije: “De ninguna manera, Señor, porque nada común o impuro ha entrado jamás en mi boca”.
es.B: Pero respondí: “¡De ningún modo, Señor! Jamás ha entrado en mi boca nada profano ni impuro”.
es.R: Pero yo dije: “¡No, Señor! ¡Yo nunca podría hacer eso! Nunca he comido nada que nuestra ley llame profano o impuro”.

fr.L: Mais j’ai dit : “Nullement, Seigneur, car rien de souillé ni d’impur n’est jamais entré dans ma bouche.”
fr.B: Mais j’ai répondu : “Certainement pas, Seigneur ! Jamais rien de souillé ni d’impur n’est entré dans ma bouche.”
fr.R: Mais j’ai dit : “Non, Seigneur ! Je ne peux pas faire ça ! Je n’ai jamais mangé ce que notre loi déclare souillé ou impur.”

sw.L: Lakini nilisema, 'Hasha, Bwana, kwa sababu kitu najisi au kichafu hakijawahi kuingia kinywani mwangu.'
sw.B: Lakini nilijibu, 'La hasha, Bwana! Hakuna kitu najisi wala kichafu kilichowahi kuingia kinywani mwangu.'
sw.R: Lakini nilisema, 'Hapana, Bwana! Siwezi kamwe kufanya hivyo! Sijawahi kula chochote ambacho sheria yetu inakiita najisi au kichafu.'

vi.L: Nhưng tôi thưa: 'Lạy Chúa, không được đâu, vì vật phàm tục hay ô uế chưa hề vào miệng con.'
vi.B: Nhưng tôi thưa: 'Lạy Chúa, không được đâu! Vật gì không thánh sạch hay ô uế chưa hề vào miệng con.'
vi.R: Nhưng tôi thưa: 'Lạy Chúa, không được! Con không thể làm vậy! Con chưa bao giờ ăn vật gì mà luật pháp của chúng con gọi là không thánh sạch hay ô uế.'

ko.L: 그러나 나는 '주님, 결코 안 됩니다. 속되거나 부정한 것은 한 번도 제 입에 들어간 적이 없습니다' 하고 말했습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 대답했습니다. '주님, 절대로 안 됩니다! 속되거나 부정한 것은 한 번도 입에 대 본 적이 없습니다.'
ko.R: 그러나 나는 말했습니다. '주님, 안 됩니다! 저는 그렇게 할 수 없습니다! 저는 우리 율법이 속되고 부정하다고 하는 것을 한 번도 먹어 본 적이 없습니다.'

decisions.choice: Lord: Peter answers the voice from heaven as the Lord
alternatives: sir, a polite address to someone unknown
decisions.reason: The word can be a polite "sir". But the voice comes from heaven (11:9), and Peter answers it as he answered in 10:14.

decisions.choice: common or unclean: food the law of Moses forbade, which made a person unfit to worship
decisions.reason: "Common" means not set apart for God, and so unholy; "unclean" is the word of Leviticus 11 and Deuteronomy 14:3-21 for animals Israel must not eat.

decisions.choice: nothing has entered my mouth: I have never eaten it
alternatives: I have never tasted such food by accident
decisions.reason: Peter means he has kept the food laws all his life.

decisions.choice: unholy
decisions.reason: In English "common" means ordinary. Balanced and Readable say what it meant in the law: not holy.

decisions.choice: that our law calls
decisions.reason: Readable says whose rule this was.

decisions.choice: souillé, as in 10:14
decisions.reason: French "commun" means ordinary and "profane" secular; "souillé" says what the law meant, food unfit for God's people (m2), and keeps Peter's retelling in the same words as the vision in chapter 10.

decisions.choice: najisi (every level)
decisions.reason: The Greek word means "common", food the law of Moses forbade (meaning decision m2). In Swahili "cha kawaida" would say only "ordinary", so even Literal uses "najisi", the word for what is ritually unfit; the same in verse 9.

decisions.choice: Peter's words to the Lord quoted in 합쇼체 with "저", inside his account to the believers, where he says "나"
decisions.reason: Peter quotes how he spoke to the Lord, as in 10:14, while he speaks to his hearers as an apostle with "나".

source.text: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ φωνὴ ἐκ δευτέρου ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ· Ἃ ὁ θεὸς ἐκαθάρισεν σὺ μὴ κοίνου.

records.literal_gloss: Answered however a voice a second [time] out of the heaven, What the God cleansed, you not be calling common.

en.L: But a voice answered a second time out of heaven, 'What God has cleansed, you must not call common.'
en.B: A second time the voice spoke from heaven: 'What God has made clean, you must not call unholy.'
en.R: The voice from heaven spoke again. It said, 'God has made these things clean. So you must not say that they are unholy.'

es.L: Pero respondió una voz por segunda vez desde el cielo: “Lo que Dios purificó, no lo tengas tú por común”.
es.B: Por segunda vez habló la voz desde el cielo: “Lo que Dios ha hecho puro, tú no lo llames profano”.
es.R: La voz del cielo habló otra vez. Me dijo: “Dios ha hecho puras estas cosas. Así que no debes decir que son profanas”.

fr.L: Mais une voix a répondu une deuxième fois du ciel : “Ce que Dieu a purifié, toi, ne le dis pas souillé.”
fr.B: Une seconde fois, la voix a parlé du ciel : “Ce que Dieu a rendu pur, tu ne dois pas le déclarer souillé.”
fr.R: La voix du ciel a parlé encore une fois. Elle a dit : “Dieu a rendu ces choses pures. Alors, tu ne dois pas dire qu’elles sont souillées.”

sw.L: Lakini sauti ilijibu mara ya pili kutoka mbinguni, 'Alichokisafisha Mungu, wewe usikihesabu kuwa najisi.'
sw.B: Kwa mara ya pili sauti ilisema kutoka mbinguni, 'Kile ambacho Mungu amekifanya safi, wewe usikiite najisi.'
sw.R: Sauti kutoka mbinguni ilizungumza tena. Ilisema, 'Mungu amevifanya vitu hivi kuwa safi. Kwa hiyo usiseme kwamba ni najisi.'

vi.L: Tiếng từ trời lại đáp lần thứ hai: 'Những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho sạch, con chớ gọi là phàm tục.'
vi.B: Tiếng từ trời lại nói lần thứ hai: 'Những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho sạch, con không được gọi là không thánh sạch.'
vi.R: Tiếng từ trời lại nói: 'Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho những vật này được sạch. Vì vậy con không được nói rằng chúng không thánh sạch.'

ko.L: 그러자 하늘에서 두 번째로 음성이 대답했습니다. '하나님께서 깨끗하게 하신 것을 너는 속되다고 하지 마라.'
ko.B: 두 번째로 하늘에서 음성이 들려왔습니다. '하나님께서 깨끗하게 하신 것을 네가 속되다고 해서는 안 된다.'
ko.R: 하늘에서 그 목소리가 다시 말했습니다. '하나님께서 이것들을 깨끗하게 하셨다. 그러니 너는 그것을 속되다고 말해서는 안 된다.'

decisions.choice: God has cleansed: God himself has declared these things clean
alternatives: Peter may now decide for himself what is clean
decisions.reason: The point is that God, not Peter, decides. Peter later applies it to people: God told him not to call anyone common or unclean (10:28), and God cleansed the Gentiles' hearts by faith (15:9).

decisions.choice: you must not call: stop treating as unholy
decisions.reason: A present command with "not" can mean to stop doing something, or not to make a habit of it.

decisions.choice: unholy
decisions.reason: As in 11:8.

source.text: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τρίς, καὶ ἀνεσπάσθη πάλιν ἅπαντα εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

records.literal_gloss: This now happened three times, and was drawn up again all into the heaven.

en.L: Now this happened three times, and everything was drawn up again into heaven.
en.B: Three times this took place, and then everything was drawn back up into heaven.
en.R: This happened three times. Then the sheet and everything in it was pulled back up into the sky.

es.L: Y esto sucedió tres veces, y todo fue retirado otra vez hacia el cielo.
es.B: Esto ocurrió tres veces, y luego todo fue alzado de nuevo al cielo.
es.R: Esto pasó tres veces. Después, la sábana y todo lo que había en ella volvió a subir al cielo.

fr.L: Or cela est arrivé trois fois, et tout a été retiré de nouveau dans le ciel.
fr.B: Cela s’est produit trois fois, puis tout a été retiré vers le ciel.
fr.R: C’est arrivé trois fois. Puis la toile, avec tout ce qu’il y avait dedans, est remontée vers le ciel.

sw.L: Na jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu, na vyote vikavutwa tena juu mbinguni.
sw.B: Hili lilitokea mara tatu, kisha vyote vikavutwa tena kurudi mbinguni.
sw.R: Jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu. Kisha shuka hiyo pamoja na vyote vilivyokuwa ndani yake vilivutwa tena juu angani.

vi.L: Việc ấy xảy ra ba lần, rồi mọi vật lại được kéo lên trời.
vi.B: Việc ấy xảy ra ba lần, rồi mọi vật lại được kéo lên trời.
vi.R: Việc ấy xảy ra ba lần. Rồi tấm khăn và mọi vật trong đó được kéo trở lên bầu trời.

ko.L: 그런데 이런 일이 세 번 있었고, 모든 것이 다시 하늘로 끌려 올라갔습니다.
ko.B: 이런 일이 세 번 있었습니다. 그런 다음에 모든 것이 다시 하늘로 끌려 올라갔습니다.
ko.R: 이런 일이 세 번이나 있었습니다. 그런 다음 그 보자기와 그 안에 있던 것이 모두 다시 하늘로 올라갔습니다.

decisions.choice: three times: the message was made certain
alternatives: Peter had to be told three times because he refused
decisions.reason: A thing said three times is firm. The text does not say why it was repeated.

decisions.choice: the sky
decisions.reason: As in 11:5.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξαυτῆς τρεῖς ἄνδρες ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐν ᾗ ἦμεν, ἀπεσταλμένοι ἀπὸ Καισαρείας πρός με.

records.literal_gloss: And behold, at once three men stood at the house in which we were, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

en.L: And look, at once three men stood at the house in which we were, sent to me from Caesarea.
en.B: At that very moment three men reached the house where we were. They had been sent to me from Caesarea.
en.R: Just then three men came to the house where we were staying. They had been sent to me from the city of Caesarea.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, en ese mismo instante tres hombres se presentaron ante la casa en la que estábamos, enviados a mí desde Cesarea.
es.B: En ese mismo momento tres hombres llegaron a la casa donde estábamos. Me los habían enviado desde Cesarea.
es.R: Justo entonces llegaron tres hombres a la casa donde nos alojábamos. Me los habían enviado desde la ciudad de Cesarea.

fr.L: Et voici qu’aussitôt trois hommes se sont présentés à la maison où nous étions, envoyés de Césarée vers moi.
fr.B: Au même instant, trois hommes sont arrivés à la maison où nous étions. On me les avait envoyés de Césarée.
fr.R: Juste à ce moment-là, trois hommes sont arrivés à la maison où nous logions. On me les avait envoyés de la ville de Césarée.

sw.L: Na tazama, mara moja watu watatu walisimama mbele ya nyumba tuliyokuwamo, wakiwa wametumwa kwangu kutoka Kaisaria.
sw.B: Wakati huo huo watu watatu walifika kwenye nyumba tuliyokuwamo. Walikuwa wametumwa kwangu kutoka Kaisaria.
sw.R: Mara hiyo watu watatu walifika kwenye nyumba tuliyokuwa tukikaa. Walikuwa wametumwa kwangu kutoka mji wa Kaisaria.

vi.L: Và kìa, ngay lúc ấy có ba người được sai từ Sê-sa-rê đến tìm tôi, đứng trước ngôi nhà chúng tôi đang ở.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy có ba người đến ngôi nhà chúng tôi đang ở. Họ được sai từ Sê-sa-rê đến tìm tôi.
vi.R: Ngay lúc ấy có ba người đến ngôi nhà chúng tôi đang ở. Họ được sai từ thành Sê-sa-rê đến tìm tôi.

ko.L: 그런데 보십시오, 바로 그때 가이사랴에서 나에게 보낸 세 사람이 우리가 있던 집 앞에 섰습니다.
ko.B: 바로 그때, 가이사랴에서 나에게 보낸 세 사람이 우리가 있던 집에 도착했습니다.
ko.R: 바로 그때 세 사람이 우리가 머물던 집에 왔습니다. 그들은 가이사랴라는 도시에서 나에게 보낸 사람들이었습니다.

decisions.choice: we were: Peter and those in the house with him
decisions.reason: The verb is plural. Peter was staying with Simon the tanner (9:43, 10:6). Some manuscripts have "I was"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: Caesarea: the city on the coast where Cornelius lived, the seat of the Roman governor
decisions.reason: This is Caesarea by the sea, about thirty miles north of Joppa (10:1, 10:24).

decisions.choice: left out; "at that very moment" and "just then" carry the surprise
decisions.reason: The Greek word draws attention to what follows. Literal keeps it as "look".

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}
decisions.reason: Peter speaks to the believers in Jerusalem, so the "look" of the Greek is plural and takes the ustedes / vosotros setting, which has no English counterpart. The same for every plural "you" in this chapter (verses 16 and 23).

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμά μοι συνελθεῖν αὐτοῖς μηδὲν διακρίναντα.

records.literal_gloss: Told now the Spirit me to go with them, nothing having made distinction.

en.L: And the Spirit told me to go with them, making no distinction.
en.B: The Spirit told me to go with them without making any distinction between them and us.
en.R: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them. He told me not to think of them as different from us.

es.L: Y el Espíritu me dijo que fuera con ellos, sin hacer distinción.
es.B: El Espíritu me dijo que fuera con ellos sin hacer ninguna distinción entre ellos y nosotros.
es.R: El Espíritu Santo me dijo que fuera con ellos. Me dijo que no los considerara diferentes de nosotros.

fr.L: Et l’Esprit m’a dit d’aller avec eux sans faire aucune distinction.
fr.B: L’Esprit m’a dit de partir avec eux sans faire de différence entre eux et nous.
fr.R: L’Esprit Saint m’a dit d’aller avec eux. Il m’a dit de ne pas les considérer comme différents de nous.

sw.L: Na Roho aliniambia niende pamoja nao, bila kubagua chochote.
sw.B: Roho aliniambia niende pamoja nao bila kufanya tofauti yoyote kati yao na sisi.
sw.R: Roho Mtakatifu aliniambia niende pamoja nao. Aliniambia nisiwaone kuwa tofauti na sisi.

vi.L: Thánh Linh bảo tôi đi với họ, đừng phân biệt gì cả.
vi.B: Thánh Linh bảo tôi đi với họ, không phân biệt họ với chúng ta.
vi.R: Đức Thánh Linh bảo tôi đi với họ. Ngài bảo tôi đừng xem họ là khác với chúng ta.

ko.L: 그리고 성령께서 나에게 아무런 차별도 하지 말고 그들과 함께 가라고 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.B: 성령께서 나에게, 그들과 우리를 조금도 차별하지 말고 그들과 함께 가라고 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.R: 성령께서 나에게 그들과 함께 가라고 말씀하셨습니다. 그 사람들을 우리와 다르게 여기지 말라고 하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: making no distinction: not treating them as different because they were Gentiles
decisions.reason: In 10:20 the Spirit tells Peter to go "doubting nothing", with the same verb in another form. Here the form is active, and it answers the complaint of 11:2: those who took issue with Peter made the very distinction the Spirit told him not to make. 15:9 says God made no distinction between Jews and Gentiles.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "making no distinction"
alternatives: some manuscripts read "not doubting", as in 10:20
some manuscripts leave the phrase out
decisions.reason: The manuscripts differ in the form of the verb, and some Western witnesses leave out the phrase. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the Spirit: the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: In 10:19-20 the Spirit tells Peter that he himself has sent the men.

decisions.choice: the Holy Spirit; He
decisions.reason: Readable names the Spirit in full and uses "he", never "it".

decisions.choice: "차별하지 말고" for mēden diakrinanta
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "making no distinction", not treating them as different because they were Gentiles (meaning decisions); in 10:20 the same verb in another form meant not hesitating, and Korean follows each reading.

source.text: ἦλθον δὲ σὺν ἐμοὶ καὶ οἱ ἓξ ἀδελφοὶ οὗτοι, καὶ εἰσήλθομεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀνδρός.

records.literal_gloss: Went now with me also the six brothers these, and we entered into the house of the man.

en.L: And these six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man's house.
en.B: These six brothers traveled with me as well, and we entered the man's house.
en.R: These six believers from Joppa went with me too. We all went into the house of the man who had sent for me.

es.L: Y fueron también conmigo estos seis hermanos, y entramos en la casa del hombre.
es.B: Estos seis hermanos también me acompañaron, y entramos en la casa de aquel hombre.
es.R: Estos seis creyentes de Jope también fueron conmigo. Todos entramos en la casa del hombre que me había mandado llamar.

fr.L: Et ces six frères aussi sont venus avec moi, et nous sommes entrés dans la maison de l’homme.
fr.B: Ces six frères m’ont accompagné, eux aussi, et nous sommes entrés dans la maison de cet homme.
fr.R: Ces six croyants de Joppé sont venus avec moi, eux aussi. Nous sommes tous entrés dans la maison de l’homme qui m’avait fait appeler.

sw.L: Na ndugu hawa sita pia walikwenda pamoja nami, nasi tukaingia katika nyumba ya mtu yule.
sw.B: Ndugu hawa sita pia walisafiri pamoja nami, tukaingia nyumbani mwa mtu huyo.
sw.R: Waumini hawa sita wa Yafa pia walikwenda pamoja nami. Sote tuliingia nyumbani mwa yule mtu aliyekuwa ameniita.

vi.L: Sáu anh em này cũng đi với tôi, và chúng tôi vào nhà người ấy.
vi.B: Sáu anh em này cũng đi với tôi, và chúng tôi vào nhà người ấy.
vi.R: Sáu tín hữu này từ Giốp-bê cũng đi với tôi. Tất cả chúng tôi đều vào nhà của người đã mời tôi.

ko.L: 그리고 이 여섯 형제도 나와 함께 갔습니다. 그리고 우리는 그 사람의 집에 들어갔습니다.
ko.B: 여기 있는 이 여섯 형제도 나와 함께 갔습니다. 그리고 우리는 그 사람의 집에 들어갔습니다.
ko.R: 욥바에서 온 이 여섯 명의 믿는 사람들도 나와 함께 갔습니다. 우리는 모두 나를 부른 그 사람의 집에 들어갔습니다.

decisions.choice: these six brothers: believers from Joppa who went with Peter, and who are now present as witnesses
decisions.reason: In 10:23 some of the brothers from Joppa go with Peter; 10:45 calls them believers from among the circumcised. "These" shows they are standing with him in Jerusalem. The law asked for two or three witnesses (Deuteronomy 19:15); Peter has six.

decisions.choice: brothers: these fellow believers, a particular group of men
decisions.reason: They are a particular group, and the masculine word is kept for them. Whether any women were among them, the text does not say.

decisions.choice: the man: Cornelius
decisions.reason: Peter does not name him, but his hearers know the story (10:1, 10:24).

decisions.choice: believers from Joppa
decisions.reason: Readable says who these brothers were.

decisions.choice: the man who had sent for me
decisions.reason: Readable says which man Peter means.

decisions.choice: "Sáu anh em này", with no gender span
decisions.reason: A particular group of men (meaning decision), so the setting the English keeps off here is kept off in Vietnamese too.

decisions.choice: "여섯 형제" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Here the brothers are a particular group of men (meaning decision), so the span for believers in general does not apply.

source.text: ἀπήγγειλεν δὲ ἡμῖν πῶς εἶδεν τὸν ἄγγελον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ σταθέντα καὶ εἰπόντα· Ἀπόστειλον εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετάπεμψαι Σίμωνα τὸν ἐπικαλούμενον Πέτρον, ὃς λαλήσει ῥήματα πρὸς σὲ ἐν οἷς σωθήσῃ σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκός σου.

records.literal_gloss: He reported then to us how he saw the angel in the house of him having stood and having said, Send to Joppa and summon Simon the [one] being called Peter, \v 14 who will speak words to you by which you will be saved, you and all the household of you.

en.L: And he reported to us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying, 'Send to Joppa and summon Simon who is called Peter, \v 14 who will speak words to you by which you will be saved, you and all your household.'
en.B: He described to us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, who said, 'Send to Joppa and have Simon, also called Peter, brought here. \v 14 He will speak words to you by which you will be saved, you and your whole household.'
en.R: He told us that he had seen an angel standing in his house. The angel said to him, 'Send some men to the town of Joppa. Bring back Simon, who is also called Peter. \v 14 He will tell you how God will save you and everyone who lives in your house.'

es.L: Y nos contó cómo había visto al ángel de pie en su casa y diciendo: “Envía a Jope y haz venir a Simón, el que es llamado Pedro, \v 14 quien te hablará palabras por las cuales serás salvo tú y toda tu casa”.
es.B: Él nos contó cómo había visto al ángel de pie en su casa, y cómo le dijo: “Manda a alguien a Jope y haz traer a Simón, al que también llaman Pedro. \v 14 Él te dirá palabras por medio de las cuales serás salvo tú, y también toda tu familia”.
es.R: Nos dijo que había visto un ángel de pie en su casa. El ángel le dijo: “Envía a unos hombres a la ciudad de Jope. Haz venir a Simón, al que también llaman Pedro. \v 14 Él te dirá cómo Dios te salvará a ti y a todos los que viven en tu casa”.

fr.L: Et il nous a raconté comment il avait vu l’ange se tenir dans sa maison et dire : “Envoie à Joppé et fais venir Simon, celui qui est surnommé Pierre, \v 14 qui te dira des paroles par lesquelles tu seras sauvé, toi et toute ta maison.”
fr.B: Il nous a raconté comment il avait vu l’ange debout dans sa maison, et comment l’ange lui avait dit : “Envoie quelqu’un à Joppé et fais venir ici Simon, qu’on appelle aussi Pierre. \v 14 Il te dira des paroles par lesquelles tu seras sauvé, toi et toute ta famille.”
fr.R: Il nous a raconté qu’il avait vu un ange debout dans sa maison. L’ange lui avait dit : “Envoie des hommes dans la ville de Joppé. Fais venir Simon, qu’on appelle aussi Pierre. \v 14 Il te dira comment Dieu va te sauver, toi et tous ceux qui vivent dans ta maison.”

sw.L: Naye alitueleza jinsi alivyomwona malaika amesimama nyumbani mwake na kusema, 'Tuma [watu] Yafa, umwite Simoni anayeitwa Petro, \v 14 ambaye atakuambia maneno ambayo kwayo utaokolewa wewe na nyumba yako yote.'
sw.B: Alitueleza jinsi alivyomwona malaika amesimama nyumbani mwake, akamwambia, 'Tuma watu Yafa wamlete Simoni, anayeitwa pia Petro. \v 14 Yeye atakuambia maneno ambayo kwa hayo utaokolewa, wewe pamoja na watu wote wa nyumbani mwako.'
sw.R: Alituambia kwamba alikuwa amemwona malaika amesimama nyumbani mwake. Malaika huyo alimwambia, 'Tuma watu waende mji wa Yafa. Mlete Simoni, anayeitwa pia Petro. \v 14 Yeye atakuambia jinsi Mungu atakavyokuokoa wewe na wote wanaoishi nyumbani mwako.'

vi.L: Người ấy kể lại cho chúng tôi thế nào ông đã thấy thiên sứ đứng trong nhà mình và nói: 'Hãy sai người đến Giốp-bê mời Si-môn, cũng gọi là Phi-e-rơ; \v 14 người ấy sẽ nói cho ông những lời mà nhờ đó ông và cả nhà ông sẽ được cứu.'
vi.B: Người ấy kể cho chúng tôi nghe ông đã thấy thiên sứ đứng trong nhà mình và nói: 'Hãy sai người đến Giốp-bê mời Si-môn, cũng gọi là Phi-e-rơ, về đây. \v 14 Người ấy sẽ nói cho ông những lời mà nhờ đó ông và cả nhà ông sẽ được cứu.'
vi.R: Người ấy kể cho chúng tôi nghe rằng ông đã thấy một thiên sứ đứng trong nhà mình. Thiên sứ nói với ông: 'Hãy sai mấy người đến thị trấn Giốp-bê. Hãy mời Si-môn, cũng gọi là Phi-e-rơ, về đây. \v 14 Người ấy sẽ nói cho ông biết Đức Chúa Trời sẽ cứu ông và mọi người trong nhà ông như thế nào.'

ko.L: 그러자 그 사람이 우리에게, 천사가 자기 집에 서서 말하는 것을 어떻게 보았는지 알려 주었습니다. '욥바로 사람을 보내어 베드로라고 불리는 시몬을 불러오너라. \v 14 그가 너와 네 온 집안이 구원받을 말씀을 너에게 전할 것이다.'
ko.B: 그 사람은 우리에게, 자기 집에 천사가 나타나 서서 이렇게 말하는 것을 보았다고 이야기했습니다. '욥바로 사람을 보내어 베드로라는 시몬을 데려오너라. \v 14 그가 너에게 말씀을 전할 것인데, 그 말씀으로 너와 네 온 집안이 구원을 받을 것이다.'
ko.R: 그 사람은 자기 집에 천사가 서 있는 것을 보았다고 우리에게 말했습니다. 천사가 그에게 이렇게 말했다고 했습니다. '욥바라는 마을로 사람들을 보내라. 그리고 베드로라고도 불리는 시몬을 데려오너라. \v 14 그가 하나님께서 너를 어떻게 구원하실지 너에게 알려 줄 것이다. 너와 네 집에 사는 모든 사람이 구원을 받을 것이다.'

decisions.choice: the angel: the angel the hearers have already heard about
decisions.reason: Peter says "the angel", as if his hearers already know of it; the story had reached Jerusalem (11:1).

decisions.choice: words by which you will be saved: the message about Jesus, which brings salvation to those who believe
alternatives: Cornelius's good deeds would save him
decisions.reason: In 10:4 God remembers Cornelius's prayers and gifts, but the angel sends him to hear Peter's words. The angel's words here add what 10:5-6 and 10:32 leave unsaid: the message would bring salvation.

decisions.choice: all your household: Cornelius's family, slaves and others who lived with him
decisions.reason: A household took in everyone under the head of the house. Cornelius had gathered his relatives and close friends (10:24), and the Spirit fell on all who heard (10:44).

decisions.choice: send some men; he will tell you how God will save you
alternatives: send to Joppa; words by which you will be saved
decisions.reason: Readable says who would go and who saves. The meaning note explains that Peter's words would bring the message of salvation.

source.text: ἐν δὲ τῷ ἄρξασθαί με λαλεῖν ἐπέπεσεν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ὥσπερ καὶ ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς ἐν ἀρχῇ.

records.literal_gloss: In then the to begin me to speak, fell the Spirit the Holy upon them even as also upon us in [the] beginning.

en.L: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them just as also upon us in [the] beginning.
en.B: I had only begun to speak when the Holy Spirit came down on them, just as the Spirit came on us at the start.
en.R: I had just started to speak to them when the Holy Spirit came on them. It happened the same way it happened to us at the beginning, on the day of Pentecost.

es.L: Y cuando yo empezaba a hablar, el Espíritu Santo cayó sobre ellos, de la misma manera que también sobre nosotros en [el] principio.
es.B: Apenas había empezado a hablar cuando el Espíritu Santo descendió sobre ellos, igual que había venido sobre nosotros al comienzo.
es.R: Yo acababa de empezar a hablarles cuando el Espíritu Santo vino sobre ellos. Pasó de la misma manera que nos pasó a nosotros al principio, el día de Pentecostés.

fr.L: Et comme je commençais à parler, l’Esprit Saint est tombé sur eux, comme sur nous aussi au commencement.
fr.B: Je venais à peine de commencer à parler quand l’Esprit Saint est descendu sur eux, comme l’Esprit était venu sur nous au début.
fr.R: Je venais juste de commencer à leur parler quand l’Esprit Saint est venu sur eux. Ça s’est passé de la même façon que pour nous au début, le jour de la Pentecôte.

sw.L: Na katika kuanza kwangu kusema, Roho Mtakatifu aliwaangukia, kama vile pia juu yetu sisi hapo mwanzo.
sw.B: Nilikuwa ndiyo kwanza nimeanza kuzungumza, na Roho Mtakatifu akaja juu yao, sawasawa na alivyokuja juu yetu hapo mwanzo.
sw.R: Nilikuwa nimeanza tu kuongea nao, ndipo Roho Mtakatifu akaja juu yao. Ilitokea kwa namna ile ile ilivyotokea kwetu mwanzoni, siku ya Pentekoste.

vi.L: Khi tôi bắt đầu nói, Đức Thánh Linh giáng xuống trên họ, cũng như đã giáng xuống trên chúng ta lúc ban đầu.
vi.B: Tôi vừa mới bắt đầu nói thì Đức Thánh Linh ngự xuống trên họ, cũng như Thánh Linh đã ngự xuống trên chúng ta lúc ban đầu.
vi.R: Tôi vừa bắt đầu nói với họ thì Đức Thánh Linh ngự xuống trên họ. Việc ấy đã xảy ra giống như đã xảy ra cho chúng ta lúc ban đầu, vào ngày Lễ Ngũ Tuần.

ko.L: 그런데 내가 말을 시작했을 때에, 성령께서 처음에 우리에게 내려오신 것처럼 그들에게도 내려오셨습니다.
ko.B: 내가 말을 시작하자마자, 성령께서 처음에 우리에게 내려오셨던 것처럼 그들에게도 내려오셨습니다.
ko.R: 내가 그들에게 말을 시작하자마자 성령께서 그들에게 오셨습니다. 처음 오순절 날에 우리에게 오셨던 것과 똑같았습니다.

decisions.choice: as I began to speak: before he had finished, while his message was still under way
alternatives: after his opening words, when he was nearly done
decisions.reason: In 10:44 the Spirit fell "while Peter was still speaking". Peter's long message in 10:34-43 shows that "began" does not mean his first sentence; the point is that God did not wait for him to finish.

decisions.choice: as on us at the beginning: as at Pentecost
decisions.reason: The beginning is the day the Spirit was poured out on the first disciples in Jerusalem (2:1-4). In 10:46 the Gentiles too spoke in tongues and praised God.

decisions.choice: on the day of Pentecost
decisions.reason: Readable says which beginning Peter means, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: ἐμνήσθην δὲ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ κυρίου ὡς ἔλεγεν· Ἰωάννης μὲν ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι, ὑμεῖς δὲ βαπτισθήσεσθε ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: I remembered then the word of the Lord how he was saying, John indeed baptized with water, you however will be baptized in [the] Spirit Holy.

en.L: And I remembered the word of the Lord, how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} used to say, 'John baptized with water, but you will be baptized in [the] Holy Spirit.'
en.B: Then the Lord's words came back to me: 'John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.'
en.R: Then I thought of the words of the Lord Jesus. He said, 'John baptized people with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.'

es.L: Y me acordé de la palabra del Señor, cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} decía: “Juan bautizó con agua, pero {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} bautizados en [el] Espíritu Santo”.
es.B: Entonces recordé las palabras del Señor: “Juan bautizó con agua, pero {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} bautizados con el Espíritu Santo”.
es.R: Entonces me acordé de lo que dijo el Señor Jesús: “Juan bautizó a la gente con agua, pero {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} bautizados con el Espíritu Santo”.

fr.L: Et je me suis souvenu de la parole du Seigneur, comment {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait : “Jean a baptisé avec de l’eau, mais vous, vous serez baptisés dans l’Esprit Saint.”
fr.B: Alors les paroles du Seigneur me sont revenues : “Jean a baptisé avec de l’eau, mais vous, vous serez baptisés dans l’Esprit Saint.”
fr.R: Alors j’ai pensé aux paroles du Seigneur Jésus. Il a dit : “Jean a baptisé les gens avec de l’eau, mais vous, vous serez baptisés dans l’Esprit Saint.”

sw.L: Nami nikalikumbuka neno la Bwana, jinsi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyokuwa akisema, 'Yohana alibatiza kwa maji, lakini ninyi mtabatizwa katika Roho Mtakatifu.'
sw.B: Kisha nikayakumbuka maneno ya Bwana, 'Yohana alibatiza kwa maji, lakini ninyi mtabatizwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu.'
sw.R: Kisha nikakumbuka maneno ya Bwana Yesu. Alisema, 'Yohana aliwabatiza watu kwa maji, lakini ninyi mtabatizwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu.'

vi.L: Bấy giờ tôi nhớ lại lời Chúa, thể nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói: 'Giăng đã làm báp-têm bằng nước, nhưng các con sẽ chịu báp-têm trong Đức Thánh Linh.'
vi.B: Bấy giờ tôi nhớ lại lời Chúa đã nói: 'Giăng đã làm báp-têm bằng nước, nhưng các con sẽ chịu báp-têm bằng Đức Thánh Linh.'
vi.R: Bấy giờ tôi nhớ lại lời của Chúa Giê-xu. Ngài đã nói: 'Giăng làm báp-têm cho người ta bằng nước, nhưng các con sẽ chịu báp-têm bằng Đức Thánh Linh.'

ko.L: 그때 나는 주님의 말씀이 생각났습니다. 주님께서 '요한은 물로 세례를 주었으나, 너희는 성령으로 세례를 받을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.B: 그때 나는 주님께서 하신 말씀이 생각났습니다. '요한은 물로 세례를 주었지만, 너희는 성령으로 세례를 받을 것이다.'
ko.R: 그때 나는 주 예수께서 하신 말씀이 생각났습니다. 예수께서는 '요한은 사람들에게 물로 세례를 주었지만, 너희는 성령으로 세례를 받을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: the Lord's words in 1:5
decisions.reason: John spoke of one who would baptize with the Holy Spirit (Luke 3:16). The risen Jesus took up the saying in 1:5, and Peter quotes that form of it.

decisions.choice: the Lord: Jesus
decisions.reason: The words quoted are the words of Jesus in 1:5.

decisions.choice: used to say: words he had spoken
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense may only mean "had said"; it can also suggest he said it more than once.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names the Lord, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: baptisés dans l’Esprit Saint at every level
alternatives: avec l’Esprit Saint (as the English Balanced and Readable "with")
decisions.reason: Peter quotes the Lord's words of 1:5, and French keeps them as drafted there: "dans" keeps the picture of being immersed in the Spirit as in water, and repeats the earlier wording so readers hear the quotation.

decisions.choice: The Lord's words worded as in 1:5
decisions.reason: Peter quotes what Jesus said in 1:5 (meaning decision), so the same Vietnamese is used.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1:5, which Peter recalls
decisions.reason: The Lord's words in 1:5 (meaning decision); the Korean repeats them so the link is plain.

source.text: εἰ οὖν τὴν ἴσην δωρεὰν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ὡς καὶ ἡμῖν πιστεύσασιν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ἐγὼ τίς ἤμην δυνατὸς κωλῦσαι τὸν θεόν;

records.literal_gloss: If then the equal gift gave to them the God as also to us having believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, I who was I able to hinder the God?

en.L: If then God gave them the same gift as also to us, having believed on the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, who was I, that I could hinder God?"
en.B: If, then, God gave them the same gift as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave us when we came to believe in the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, who was I? Could I hinder God?"
en.R: God gave those people the same gift that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave us when we believed in the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. So who was I to try to stop God?"

es.L: Si, pues, Dios les dio a ellos el mismo don que también a nosotros, que creímos en el Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, ¿quién era yo para poder estorbar a Dios?».
es.B: Si Dios les dio a ellos el mismo don que nos dio a nosotros cuando creímos en el Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, ¿quién era yo? ¿Podía yo impedírselo a Dios?».
es.R: Dios les dio a esas personas el mismo regalo que nos dio a nosotros cuando creímos en el Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}. Entonces, ¿quién era yo para tratar de impedírselo a Dios?».

fr.L: Si donc Dieu leur a donné le même don qu’à nous aussi, qui avons cru au Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, qui étais-je, moi, pour pouvoir empêcher Dieu ? »
fr.B: Si donc Dieu leur a fait le même don qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a fait quand nous avons cru au Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, qui étais-je ? Pouvais-je faire obstacle à Dieu ? »
fr.R: Dieu a donné à ces gens le même cadeau qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné quand nous avons cru au Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. Alors, qui étais-je pour essayer d’arrêter Dieu ? »

sw.L: Basi ikiwa Mungu aliwapa wao kipawa kilekile kama alivyotupa sisi pia tulioamini katika Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mimi nilikuwa nani hata niweze kumzuia Mungu?"
sw.B: Basi, ikiwa Mungu aliwapa wao zawadi ileile aliyotupa sisi tulipomwamini Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mimi nilikuwa nani? Je, ningeweza kumzuia Mungu?"
sw.R: Mungu aliwapa watu hao zawadi ileile aliyotupa sisi tulipomwamini Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Kwa hiyo mimi ni nani hata nijaribu kumzuia Mungu?"

vi.L: Vậy nếu Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho họ cùng một ân tứ như cho chúng ta là những người đã tin Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, thì tôi là ai mà có thể ngăn cản Đức Chúa Trời?"
vi.B: Vậy nếu Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho họ cùng một món quà như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta khi chúng ta tin Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, thì tôi là ai? Tôi có thể ngăn cản Đức Chúa Trời được sao?"
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho những người ấy cùng một món quà mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta khi chúng ta tin Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Vậy tôi là ai mà dám ngăn cản Đức Chúa Trời?"

ko.L: 그러니 우리가 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿었을 때에 우리에게 주신 것과 똑같은 선물을 하나님께서 그들에게도 주셨다면, 내가 누구이기에 하나님을 막을 수 있었겠습니까?"
ko.B: 우리가 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿게 되었을 때에 우리에게 주신 것과 똑같은 선물을 하나님께서 그들에게도 주셨는데, 내가 누구라고 하나님을 막을 수 있었겠습니까?"
ko.R: 하나님께서는 우리가 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿었을 때에 우리에게 주신 것과 똑같은 선물을 그 사람들에게도 주셨습니다. 그러니 내가 누구라고 하나님을 막으려 하겠습니까?"

decisions.choice: the same gift: the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: In 2:38 the Holy Spirit is called a gift, and 10:45 says the gift of the Spirit was poured out on the Gentiles.

decisions.choice: having believed: when we came to believe, which points to faith as the ground of the gift
alternatives: the participle refers to the Gentiles too: to them and to us, who believed
decisions.reason: The participle agrees with "us", but its point covers both groups: God gave the Spirit to all who believed in the Lord Jesus. 15:8-9 makes the same point.

decisions.choice: who was I to hinder God: Peter could not refuse baptism to people God had accepted
alternatives: Peter was not strong enough to stop God
decisions.reason: The question looks back to 10:47: no one could withhold the water of baptism from those who had received the Spirit.

decisions.choice: he gave us
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat the verb that the Greek leaves understood.

decisions.choice: a statement and then a question, without "if"
decisions.reason: The "if" states something both sides accept; Readable says it as a fact.

decisions.choice: nos dio, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable supply "he gave us" with a span on "he". Spanish leaves the subject pronoun inside the verb ("nos dio"), so there is nothing separate to capitalise; spans go only on separate pronouns, as in verse 16 and throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: aliyotupa, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable supply "he gave us" with a span on "he". Swahili marks the subject inside the verb ("aliyotupa"), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so a span goes only on a free pronoun, as in verse 16.

decisions.choice: "Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}" for "the Lord Jesus Christ"
decisions.reason: The form of the Vietnamese letters for this title (Romans 1:7).

source.text: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ταῦτα ἡσύχασαν καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν θεὸν λέγοντες· Ἄρα καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὁ θεὸς τὴν μετάνοιαν εἰς ζωὴν ἔδωκεν.

records.literal_gloss: Having heard then these things they were silent, and glorified the God saying, Then also to the Gentiles the God the repentance unto life has given.

en.L: And having heard these things they fell silent, and they glorified God, saying, "Then also to the Gentiles God has given repentance [leading] to life."
en.B: At this they fell silent and glorified God. "Then God has given even the Gentiles repentance that brings life," they said.
en.R: When the believers in Jerusalem heard this, they stopped arguing. They gave glory to God and said, "So God has let people who are not Jews turn away from their sins too. Now they can have eternal life as well."

es.L: Y habiendo oído estas cosas guardaron silencio y glorificaron a Dios, diciendo: «Así que también a los gentiles Dios les ha concedido el arrepentimiento [que conduce] a la vida».
es.B: Al oír esto, se quedaron callados y glorificaron a Dios. «Entonces Dios ha concedido también a los gentiles el arrepentimiento que lleva a la vida», decían.
es.R: Cuando los creyentes de Jerusalén oyeron esto, dejaron de discutir. Dieron gloria a Dios y dijeron: «Así que Dios también ha permitido que los que no son judíos se aparten de sus pecados. Ahora ellos también pueden tener vida eterna».

fr.L: Et, ayant entendu cela, ils se turent et glorifièrent Dieu en disant : « Ainsi donc, aux nations aussi Dieu a donné la repentance [qui mène] à la vie. »
fr.B: À ces mots, ils se turent et glorifièrent Dieu. « Dieu a donc accordé même aux non-Juifs la repentance qui conduit à la vie ! » disaient-ils.
fr.R: Quand les croyants de Jérusalem ont entendu cela, ils ont arrêté de discuter. Ils ont rendu gloire à Dieu et ils ont dit : « Alors, Dieu a permis aussi aux gens qui ne sont pas juifs de se détourner de leurs péchés ! Maintenant, eux aussi peuvent avoir la vie éternelle. »

sw.L: Na waliposikia mambo haya walinyamaza, wakamtukuza Mungu, wakisema, "Basi hata watu wa mataifa Mungu amewapa toba iongozayo kwenye uzima."
sw.B: Waliposikia hayo, walinyamaza, wakamtukuza Mungu, wakisema, "Kumbe Mungu amewajalia hata watu wa mataifa toba inayoleta uzima!"
sw.R: Waumini wa Yerusalemu waliposikia hayo, waliacha kubishana. Walimtukuza Mungu, wakasema, "Kumbe Mungu amewawezesha hata watu wasio Wayahudi kuacha dhambi zao na kumgeukia! Sasa wao pia wanaweza kupata uzima wa milele."

vi.L: Nghe những lời ấy, họ im lặng và tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời mà nói: "Vậy thì Đức Chúa Trời cũng đã ban cho các dân ngoại sự ăn năn để được sự sống."
vi.B: Nghe vậy, họ không còn nói gì nữa và tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời. Họ nói: "Vậy là Đức Chúa Trời cũng đã ban cho các dân ngoại sự ăn năn dẫn đến sự sống."
vi.R: Khi các tín hữu ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nghe điều này, họ thôi tranh cãi. Họ tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời và nói: "Vậy là Đức Chúa Trời cũng cho những người không phải Do Thái từ bỏ tội lỗi và quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Bây giờ họ cũng có thể có sự sống đời đời."

ko.L: 그들이 이 말을 듣고 잠잠해졌다. 그리고 하나님께 영광을 돌리며 말했다. "그렇다면 하나님께서 이방 사람들에게도 생명에 이르는 회개를 주셨다."
ko.B: 이 말을 듣고 그들은 더 이상 아무 말도 하지 않았다. 그리고 하나님께 영광을 돌리며 말했다. "그렇다면 하나님께서 이방 사람들에게도 생명으로 이끄는 회개를 주셨구나."
ko.R: 예루살렘의 믿는 사람들은 이 말을 듣고 더 이상 따지지 않았다. 그들은 하나님께 영광을 돌리며 말했다. "그렇다면 하나님께서 유대인이 아닌 사람들도 죄에서 돌이키게 하셨구나. 이제 그들도 영원한 생명을 얻을 수 있게 되었구나."

decisions.choice: they fell silent: they stopped finding fault
decisions.reason: They are not silent for long; they go on to praise God. Their objection ended.

decisions.choice: repentance that leads to life: a turning to God that God himself gives, and that brings eternal life
decisions.reason: The believers say God "has given" repentance, as Peter said of Israel in 5:31. "Life" here is the life of the age to come (13:46, 13:48).

decisions.choice: so then ... too: a conclusion they had not expected
decisions.reason: The words draw a conclusion from what Peter told them. The text does not say whether they said it gladly or slowly; they praise God as they say it.

decisions.choice: turn away from their sins; have eternal life
decisions.reason: Readable says what repentance and life mean here, as the meaning note explains. "Eternal" makes plain that life means the life God gives.

decisions.choice: gave glory to God
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plainer phrase with the same word.

decisions.choice: la repentance (L, B); se détourner de leurs péchés (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles for the New Testament: "la repentance" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does (m2). "Le repentir" stresses regret more than the turning to God that the word names.

decisions.choice: "sự ăn năn để được sự sống" (L), "dẫn đến sự sống" (B); "sự sống đời đời" (R)
decisions.reason: A turning to God that God himself gives, and that brings eternal life (meaning decision); "sự sống" is the key term for "zōē".

decisions.choice: the believers speak among themselves in 해라체 ("주셨구나")
decisions.reason: A conclusion they had not expected (meaning decision), said to one another in the plain style. "생명에 이르는 회개" (L), "생명으로 이끄는 회개" (B), with "영원한 생명" at Readable, as the English Readable says "eternal life".

source.text: Οἱ μὲν οὖν διασπαρέντες ἀπὸ τῆς θλίψεως τῆς γενομένης ἐπὶ Στεφάνῳ διῆλθον ἕως Φοινίκης καὶ Κύπρου καὶ Ἀντιοχείας μηδενὶ λαλοῦντες τὸν λόγον εἰ μὴ μόνον Ἰουδαίοις.

records.literal_gloss: Those indeed therefore having been scattered from the affliction having taken place over Stephen passed through as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus and Antioch, to no one speaking the word except only to Jews.

en.L: Now those who had been scattered because of the affliction that came about over Stephen went through as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except only to Jews.
en.B: Meanwhile, the believers who had been scattered by the trouble that arose over Stephen made their way to Phoenicia, Cyprus and Antioch. They spoke the message to Jews and to no one else.
en.R: After Stephen was killed, the believers in Jerusalem were treated cruelly, and many of them had to leave the city. Some of them went as far as Phoenicia, the island of Cyprus and the city of Antioch. They told the message about Jesus only to Jews.

es.L: Así pues, los que habían sido dispersados por la tribulación que sobrevino a causa de Esteban pasaron hasta Fenicia y Chipre y Antioquía, sin hablar la palabra a nadie excepto solo a judíos.
es.B: Mientras tanto, los creyentes que se habían dispersado por la tribulación que se desató a raíz de lo de Esteban llegaron hasta Fenicia, Chipre y Antioquía. Anunciaban el mensaje a los judíos y a nadie más.
es.R: Después de que mataron a Esteban, los creyentes de Jerusalén fueron tratados con crueldad, y muchos tuvieron que salir de la ciudad. Algunos llegaron hasta Fenicia, la isla de Chipre y la ciudad de Antioquía. Contaban el mensaje acerca de Jesús solo a los judíos.

fr.L: Ceux donc qui avaient été dispersés par la détresse survenue à cause d’Étienne passèrent jusqu’en Phénicie, à Chypre et à Antioche, n’annonçant la parole à personne, sinon aux Juifs seulement.
fr.B: Pendant ce temps, les croyants que la persécution déclenchée à propos d’Étienne avait dispersés allèrent jusqu’en Phénicie, à Chypre et à Antioche. Ils n’annonçaient le message qu’aux Juifs, et à personne d’autre.
fr.R: Après la mort d’Étienne, les croyants de Jérusalem ont été maltraités, et beaucoup d’entre eux ont dû quitter la ville. Certains sont allés jusqu’en Phénicie, dans l’île de Chypre et dans la ville d’Antioche. Ils annonçaient le message au sujet de Jésus seulement aux Juifs.

sw.L: Basi wale waliotawanywa kwa sababu ya dhiki iliyotokea juu ya Stefano walipita mpaka Foinike na Kipro na Antiokia, bila kumwambia mtu yeyote neno isipokuwa Wayahudi peke yao.
sw.B: Wakati huo waumini waliokuwa wametawanyika kwa sababu ya dhiki iliyotokea kuhusu Stefano walifika hadi Foinike, Kipro na Antiokia. Waliwaambia ujumbe huo Wayahudi tu, wala si mtu mwingine yeyote.
sw.R: Baada ya Stefano kuuawa, waumini wa Yerusalemu walitendewa ukatili, na wengi wao walilazimika kuuacha mji. Baadhi yao walifika mpaka Foinike, kisiwa cha Kipro, na mji wa Antiokia. Waliwaambia Wayahudi tu ujumbe kuhusu Yesu.

vi.L: Vậy những người đã bị tản lạc vì cơn hoạn nạn xảy ra từ vụ Ê-tiên đi đến tận Phê-ni-xi, Chíp-rơ và An-ti-ốt, không giảng lời cho ai ngoài người Do Thái.
vi.B: Trong khi đó, những tín hữu bị tản lạc vì cuộc bắt bớ xảy ra từ vụ Ê-tiên đã đi đến Phê-ni-xi, Chíp-rơ và An-ti-ốt. Họ chỉ giảng sứ điệp cho người Do Thái mà thôi.
vi.R: Sau khi Ê-tiên bị giết, các tín hữu ở Giê-ru-sa-lem bị đối xử tàn ác, và nhiều người trong họ phải rời khỏi thành. Một số người đi đến tận miền Phê-ni-xi, đảo Chíp-rơ và thành An-ti-ốt. Họ chỉ nói sứ điệp về Đức Giê-xu cho người Do Thái mà thôi.

ko.L: 그런데 스데반의 일로 일어난 환난 때문에 흩어진 사람들이 베니게와 구브로와 안디옥까지 두루 다니며, 유대인들에게만 말씀을 전하고 다른 누구에게도 전하지 않았다.
ko.B: 한편, 스데반의 일로 일어난 박해 때문에 흩어진 신자들은 베니게와 구브로와 안디옥까지 가서, 유대인들에게만 말씀을 전하고 다른 사람에게는 전하지 않았다.
ko.R: 스데반이 죽임을 당한 뒤에, 예루살렘의 믿는 사람들은 심한 괴롭힘을 당했다. 그래서 많은 사람이 그 도시를 떠났다. 그들 가운데 몇 사람은 멀리 베니게와 구브로 섬과 안디옥이라는 도시까지 갔다. 그들은 예수에 관한 말씀을 유대인들에게만 전했다.

decisions.choice: those who had been scattered: the believers who fled Jerusalem after Stephen's death
decisions.reason: The words take up 8:1-4, where the same verb is used. Luke now follows another line of the story from that point.

decisions.choice: affliction: the persecution of the believers
decisions.reason: The word means pressure and trouble; here it is the attack that began with Stephen's death (8:1-3).

decisions.choice: Phoenicia, Cyprus, Antioch: the coast north of Galilee, the island off it, and the great city of Syria
decisions.reason: This Antioch is the capital of the Roman province of Syria, on the Orontes river. Josephus calls it the third city of the Roman world (Jewish War 3.29), and it had a large Jewish community.

decisions.choice: after Stephen was killed ... many of them had to leave the city
alternatives: those scattered because of the affliction over Stephen
decisions.reason: Readable retells what 8:1-4 says, so the reader knows who these people were.

decisions.choice: the message about Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word was.

decisions.choice: "Phê-ni-xi", "Chíp-rơ", "An-ti-ốt"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names.

decisions.choice: "환난" (L), "박해" (B), "괴롭힘" (R) for thlipsis; "베니게", "구브로", "안디옥"
decisions.reason: The affliction is the persecution of the believers (meaning decision). The Protestant forms of the names (style guide, Settled), as in 4:36 and 6:5.

source.text: ἦσαν δέ τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν ἄνδρες Κύπριοι καὶ Κυρηναῖοι, οἵτινες ἐλθόντες εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν ἐλάλουν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς Ἑλληνιστάς, εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν.

records.literal_gloss: Were however some of them men of Cyprus and of Cyrene, who having come into Antioch were speaking also to the Hellenists, proclaiming the good news [of] the Lord Jesus.

en.L: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, having come to Antioch, began speaking to the Hellenists also, proclaiming the good news of the Lord Jesus.
en.B: Some of them, though, were from Cyprus and Cyrene. When they came to Antioch, they spoke to Greek-speaking Gentiles too and announced to them the good news of the Lord Jesus.
en.R: But some of these believers came from Cyprus and from Cyrene in North Africa. They went to Antioch and spoke to people who were not Jews, people who spoke Greek. They told them the good news about the Lord Jesus.

es.L: Pero había entre ellos algunos hombres de Chipre y de Cirene, los cuales, al llegar a Antioquía, hablaban también a los helenistas, anunciando la buena noticia del Señor Jesús.
es.B: Sin embargo, algunos de ellos eran de Chipre y de Cirene. Cuando llegaron a Antioquía, hablaron también a gentiles de habla griega y les anunciaron la buena noticia del Señor Jesús.
es.R: Pero algunos de estos creyentes eran de Chipre y de Cirene, en el norte de África. Fueron a Antioquía y hablaron con personas que no eran judías, personas que hablaban griego. Les contaron la buena noticia acerca del Señor Jesús.

fr.L: Mais il y avait parmi eux quelques hommes de Chypre et de Cyrène qui, venus à Antioche, parlaient aussi aux Hellénistes, leur annonçant la bonne nouvelle du Seigneur Jésus.
fr.B: Certains d’entre eux, pourtant, étaient de Chypre et de Cyrène. Arrivés à Antioche, ils s’adressèrent aussi à des non-Juifs de langue grecque et leur annoncèrent la bonne nouvelle du Seigneur Jésus.
fr.R: Mais certains de ces croyants venaient de Chypre et de Cyrène, en Afrique du Nord. Ils sont allés à Antioche, et ils ont parlé à des gens qui n’étaient pas juifs, des gens qui parlaient grec. Ils leur ont annoncé la bonne nouvelle du Seigneur Jésus.

sw.L: Lakini walikuwako baadhi yao, watu wa Kipro na Kirene, ambao walipofika Antiokia walikuwa wakisema pia na wale wanaozungumza Kigiriki, wakihubiri habari njema ya Bwana Yesu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, baadhi yao walikuwa watu wa Kipro na Kirene. Walipofika Antiokia, waliwaambia pia watu wa mataifa wanaozungumza Kigiriki, wakawahubiri habari njema ya Bwana Yesu.
sw.R: Lakini baadhi ya waumini hao walitoka Kipro na Kirene, katika Afrika ya Kaskazini. Walikwenda Antiokia, wakazungumza na watu wasio Wayahudi, watu waliozungumza Kigiriki. Waliwaeleza habari njema kuhusu Bwana Yesu.

vi.L: Nhưng trong số họ có mấy người quê ở Chíp-rơ và Sy-ren, khi đến An-ti-ốt cũng giảng cho người Hy Lạp, rao truyền Tin Lành về Chúa Giê-xu.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, có mấy người trong số họ quê ở Chíp-rơ và Sy-ren. Khi đến An-ti-ốt, họ cũng nói với những người ngoại nói tiếng Hy Lạp, rao truyền cho họ Tin Lành về Chúa Giê-xu.
vi.R: Nhưng có mấy tín hữu quê ở đảo Chíp-rơ và thành Sy-ren ở Bắc Phi. Họ đến An-ti-ốt và nói chuyện với những người không phải Do Thái, là những người nói tiếng Hy Lạp. Họ nói cho những người ấy biết Tin Lành về Chúa Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그러나 그들 가운데 구브로 사람과 구레네 사람 몇이 있었는데, 그들은 안디옥에 와서 헬라파 사람들에게도 말하며 주 예수에 관한 복음을 전했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들 가운데는 구브로와 구레네 출신의 사람들도 있었다. 그들은 안디옥에 와서 그리스 말을 하는 이방 사람들에게도 주 예수에 관한 기쁜 소식을 전했다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 믿는 사람들 가운데 몇 사람은 구브로와 북아프리카의 구레네에서 온 사람들이었다. 그들은 안디옥에 가서 그리스 말을 하는, 유대인이 아닌 사람들에게도 말했다. 그들은 그 사람들에게 주 예수에 관한 기쁜 소식을 전했다.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "the Hellenists"
decisions.reason: Some important manuscripts read "Hellenists", a word used in 6:1 and 9:29 for Greek-speaking Jews. Others, also early, read "Greeks", the usual word for non-Jews. The SBLGNT prints "Hellenists". Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the Hellenists: Greek-speaking people who were not Jews
decisions.reason: Here they are set against "Jews only" in 11:19, and the story follows Peter's report about Gentiles. So, whichever word is read, those meant are Gentiles who spoke Greek. If they were Greek-speaking Jews, nothing new would be happening.

decisions.choice: Cyrene: a city in North Africa, in what is now Libya, with a Jewish community
decisions.reason: Jews from Cyrene were in Jerusalem at Pentecost (2:10) and had a synagogue there (6:9). Simon who carried Jesus's cross came from Cyrene (Luke 23:26).

decisions.choice: began speaking: a new practice, kept up
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures continued action.

decisions.choice: the good news
decisions.reason: The Greek has the verb "to tell good news", not the noun "gospel"; every level puts it as good news.

decisions.choice: Greek-speaking Gentiles; people who were not Jews, people who spoke Greek
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who these people were, as the meaning note reads it. Literal keeps the word of the SBLGNT.

decisions.choice: anunciando la buena noticia (every level)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet words for the Greek verb "to announce good news", recorded once in this chapter. "Evangelio" is kept for the noun where it names the message; here Luke describes the act of announcing it.

decisions.choice: los helenistas (L); gentiles de habla griega (B); personas que no eran judías, personas que hablaban griego (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Luke's word; Balanced and Readable say who they were, Greek speakers who were not Jews (meaning decision m2), as the English does. "Los griegos" would follow a different reading of the Greek text (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: annoncer la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek has the verb "to tell good news", not the noun "gospel", so French uses the phrase at every level, as the English does; the term sheet's "l’Évangile" is for the noun.

decisions.choice: wakihubiri habari njema (every level)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet words for the Greek verb "to announce good news", recorded once in this chapter. "Injili" is kept for the noun where it names the message; here Luke describes the act of announcing it.

decisions.choice: wale wanaozungumza Kigiriki (L); watu wa mataifa wanaozungumza Kigiriki (B); watu wasio Wayahudi, watu waliozungumza Kigiriki (R)
decisions.reason: "Kigiriki" for the Greek language as elsewhere in Acts (6:1, 9:29, 21:37). Swahili has no everyday word for "Hellenists", Greek speakers who were not Jews (meaning decision m2), so every level describes them. "Wayunani", "Greeks", would follow a different reading of the Greek text (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "người Hy Lạp" (L); "những người ngoại nói tiếng Hy Lạp" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the Hellenists are Greek-speaking people who were not Jews (meaning decision), unlike 6:1 and 9:29.

decisions.choice: "헬라파 사람들" (L), "그리스 말을 하는 이방 사람들" (B), "그리스 말을 하는, 유대인이 아닌 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "the Hellenists", here Greek-speaking people who were not Jews (meaning decisions). Literal keeps the word of 6:1 and 9:29, so the reader sees the Greek is the same; Balanced and Readable say who they were, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ἦν χεὶρ κυρίου μετ’ αὐτῶν, πολύς τε ἀριθμὸς ὁ πιστεύσας ἐπέστρεψεν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον.

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] hand of [the] Lord with them, great then number the [one] having believed turned to the Lord.

en.L: And [the] hand of [the] Lord was with them, and a great number who believed turned to the Lord.
en.B: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a large number who believed turned to the Lord.
en.R: The Lord's power was with these believers. Many people believed and turned to the Lord.

es.L: Y [la] mano [del] Señor estaba con ellos, y un gran número, el que creyó, se volvió al Señor.
es.B: La mano del Señor los acompañaba, y fueron muchos los que creyeron y se volvieron al Señor.
es.R: El poder del Señor estaba con estos creyentes. Mucha gente creyó y se volvió al Señor.
