fr.L: Et [la] main du Seigneur était avec eux, et un grand nombre, ayant cru, se tourna vers le Seigneur.
fr.B: La main du Seigneur était avec eux, et un grand nombre de gens crurent et se tournèrent vers le Seigneur.
fr.R: La puissance du Seigneur était avec ces croyants. Beaucoup de gens ont cru et se sont tournés vers le Seigneur.

sw.L: Na mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja nao, na idadi kubwa, ile iliyoamini, ilimgeukia Bwana.
sw.B: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa nao, na idadi kubwa ya watu iliamini na kumgeukia Bwana.
sw.R: Nguvu za Bwana zilikuwa pamoja na waumini hao. Watu wengi waliamini, wakamgeukia Bwana.

vi.L: Tay Chúa ở với họ, và có rất đông người tin và quay về với Chúa.
vi.B: Tay Chúa ở với họ, và có rất đông người tin và quay về với Chúa.
vi.R: Quyền năng của Chúa ở với các tín hữu ấy. Nhiều người đã tin và quay về với Chúa.

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 손이 그들과 함께하셨으므로, 많은 사람이 믿고 주님께로 돌아왔다.
ko.B: 주님의 손이 그들과 함께하시니, 많은 사람이 믿고 주님께로 돌아왔다.
ko.R: 주님께서 능력으로 이 믿는 사람들과 함께하셨다. 그래서 많은 사람이 믿고 주님께 돌아왔다.

decisions.choice: the hand of the Lord: the Lord's power at work
decisions.reason: In the Scriptures God's hand stands for his power, to help or to punish (Luke 1:66; Acts 4:28, 4:30, 13:11).

decisions.choice: the Lord: probably the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: The good news was about the Lord Jesus (11:20), and believers "turn to the Lord" in 9:35. The hand of the Lord could also be God's, as in 4:28-30.

decisions.choice: believed and turned: turned to the Lord by believing
decisions.reason: The participle "having believed" goes with "turned"; their turning was the faith they put in the Lord.

decisions.choice: power
decisions.reason: Readable says what the hand means, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: "Tay Chúa" (L, B); "Quyền năng của Chúa" (R)
decisions.reason: The Lord's power at work (meaning decision); Vietnamese readers know the Bible's picture of God's hand.

source.text: ἠκούσθη δὲ ὁ λόγος εἰς τὰ ὦτα τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς οὔσης ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ περὶ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν Βαρναβᾶν ἕως Ἀντιοχείας·

records.literal_gloss: Was heard now the word in the ears of the church the [one] being in Jerusalem concerning them, and they sent out Barnabas as far as Antioch.

en.L: And the report concerning them was heard in the ears of the church that was in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas out as far as Antioch.
en.B: The church in Jerusalem got word of these things, and it sent Barnabas out to Antioch.
en.R: The church in Jerusalem heard about what was happening in Antioch. So they sent Barnabas there.

es.L: Y se oyó la noticia acerca de ellos en los oídos de la iglesia que estaba en Jerusalén, y enviaron a Bernabé hasta Antioquía.
es.B: La noticia de estas cosas llegó a oídos de la iglesia de Jerusalén, y esta envió a Bernabé a Antioquía.
es.R: La iglesia de Jerusalén supo lo que estaba pasando en Antioquía. Por eso enviaron allá a Bernabé.

fr.L: Et la nouvelle à leur sujet parvint aux oreilles de l’église qui était à Jérusalem, et ils envoyèrent Barnabas jusqu’à Antioche.
fr.B: L’église de Jérusalem apprit ces choses et envoya Barnabas à Antioche.
fr.R: L’église de Jérusalem a appris ce qui se passait à Antioche. Alors elle a envoyé Barnabas là-bas.

sw.L: Na habari zao zilisikika masikioni mwa kanisa lililokuwa Yerusalemu, nao wakamtuma Barnaba hadi Antiokia.
sw.B: Habari hizo zilifika kwa kanisa la Yerusalemu, nalo likamtuma Barnaba aende Antiokia.
sw.R: Kanisa la Yerusalemu lilisikia mambo yaliyokuwa yakitokea Antiokia. Kwa hiyo walimtuma Barnaba huko.

vi.L: Tin về họ đến tai Hội Thánh ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, nên Hội Thánh sai Ba-na-ba đến tận An-ti-ốt.
vi.B: Hội Thánh ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nghe tin về những việc ấy, nên sai Ba-na-ba đi An-ti-ốt.
vi.R: Hội Thánh ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nghe về những việc đang xảy ra tại An-ti-ốt. Vì vậy họ sai Ba-na-ba đến đó.

ko.L: 그런데 그들에 관한 소식이 예루살렘에 있는 교회의 귀에 들어갔다. 그래서 그들은 바나바를 안디옥까지 보냈다.
ko.B: 이 소식이 예루살렘 교회에 전해지자, 교회는 바나바를 안디옥으로 보냈다.
ko.R: 예루살렘 교회는 안디옥에서 일어나고 있는 일에 관하여 들었다. 그래서 교회는 바나바를 그곳에 보냈다.

decisions.choice: word: the report, the news
decisions.reason: The same noun is used for the message of God in 11:1 and 11:19; here, with "concerning them", it means the news about the believers in Antioch.

decisions.choice: heard in the ears of the church: the church came to hear of it
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of speaking (Isaiah 5:9); it means only that the news reached them.

decisions.choice: Barnabas: Joseph of Cyprus, a Levite whom the apostles called Barnabas
decisions.reason: He was introduced in 4:36-37 and vouched for Saul in 9:27. He came from Cyprus, as did some of the men who preached in Antioch (11:20).

decisions.choice: the church in Jerusalem heard about
alternatives: the report was heard in the ears of the church
decisions.reason: Readable puts the idiom plainly.

decisions.choice: l’église (lower case) for the congregation in Jerusalem, and in Antioch (11:26)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles: "l’Église" with a capital is the whole body of believers; one congregation in one city is "l’église".

source.text: ὃς παραγενόμενος καὶ ἰδὼν τὴν χάριν τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐχάρη καὶ παρεκάλει πάντας τῇ προθέσει τῆς καρδίας προσμένειν τῷ κυρίῳ, ὅτι ἦν ἀνὴρ ἀγαθὸς καὶ πλήρης πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ πίστεως.

records.literal_gloss: Who having arrived and having seen the grace of the God rejoiced and was exhorting all with the purpose of the heart to remain with the Lord, \v 24 for he was a man good and full of [the] Spirit Holy and of faith.

en.L: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced, and he began encouraging them all to remain with the Lord with purpose of heart, \v 24 for he was a good man and full of [the] Holy Spirit and of faith.
en.B: On his arrival he saw the grace of God, and it made him glad. He kept urging everyone to hold fast to the Lord with firm resolve, \v 24 for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith.
en.R: When Barnabas got there, he saw what God's grace had done for these people, and he was very happy. He kept telling all of them, "Decide in your hearts to stay faithful to the Lord." \v 24 Barnabas was a good man. He was full of the Holy Spirit and full of faith.

es.L: El cual, habiendo llegado y visto la gracia de Dios, se alegró, y exhortaba a todos a permanecer en el Señor con el propósito del corazón, \v 24 porque era un hombre bueno y lleno de Espíritu Santo y de fe.
es.B: Cuando llegó y vio la gracia de Dios, se alegró mucho, y animaba a todos a mantenerse fieles al Señor con firme determinación, \v 24 porque era un hombre bueno, lleno del Espíritu Santo y de fe.
es.R: Cuando Bernabé llegó, vio lo que la gracia de Dios había hecho en esas personas, y se puso muy contento. A todos les decía: «{{plural_you:Decidan|Decidid}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón seguir fieles al Señor». \v 24 Bernabé era un hombre bueno. Estaba lleno del Espíritu Santo y lleno de fe.

fr.L: Quand il arriva et vit la grâce de Dieu, il se réjouit, et il les exhortait tous à demeurer attachés au Seigneur d’un cœur résolu, \v 24 car c’était un homme bon et plein d’Esprit Saint et de foi.
fr.B: À son arrivée, il vit la grâce de Dieu et s’en réjouit. Il les encourageait tous à rester attachés au Seigneur d’un cœur ferme, \v 24 car c’était un homme bon, rempli d’Esprit Saint et de foi.
fr.R: Quand Barnabas est arrivé, il a vu ce que la grâce de Dieu avait fait pour ces gens, et il a été très heureux. Il leur disait à tous : « Décidez dans votre cœur de rester fidèles au Seigneur. » \v 24 Barnabas était un homme bon. Il était rempli de l’Esprit Saint et rempli de foi.

sw.L: Yeye, alipowasili na kuiona neema ya Mungu, alifurahi, akawa akiwasihi wote kudumu na Bwana kwa nia thabiti ya moyo, \v 24 kwa maana alikuwa mtu mwema na mwenye kujaa Roho Mtakatifu na imani.
sw.B: Alipowasili na kuiona neema ya Mungu, alifurahi sana. Aliendelea kuwatia moyo wote washikamane na Bwana kwa moyo thabiti, \v 24 kwa kuwa alikuwa mtu mwema, mwenye kujawa na Roho Mtakatifu na imani.
sw.R: Barnaba alipofika huko, aliona mambo ambayo neema ya Mungu ilikuwa imewatendea watu hao, akafurahi sana. Aliendelea kuwaambia wote, "Kusudieni mioyoni mwenu kubaki waaminifu kwa Bwana." \v 24 Barnaba alikuwa mtu mwema. Alikuwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu na imani.

vi.L: Khi đến nơi và thấy ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời, ông vui mừng và khuyên mọi người hãy giữ lòng quyết tâm ở với Chúa, \v 24 vì ông là người tốt, đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh và đức tin.
vi.B: Khi đến nơi và thấy ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời, ông rất vui mừng. Ông khuyến khích mọi người hãy hết lòng quyết tâm bám chặt lấy Chúa, \v 24 vì ông là một người tốt, đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh và đức tin.
vi.R: Khi đến nơi, Ba-na-ba thấy những gì ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho những người ấy, và ông rất vui mừng. Ông cứ khuyên tất cả họ: "Hãy quyết tâm trong lòng luôn trung tín với Chúa." \v 24 Ba-na-ba là một người tốt. Ông đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh và đầy đức tin.

ko.L: 그가 가서 하나님의 은혜를 보고 기뻐하며, 모든 사람에게 굳은 마음으로 주님 안에 머물러 있으라고 권했다. \v 24 그는 착한 사람이었고, 성령과 믿음이 충만한 사람이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 바나바는 그곳에 가서 하나님의 은혜가 나타난 것을 보고 기뻐했다. 그리고 모든 사람에게 굳은 결심으로 주님께 붙어 있으라고 권했다. \v 24 그는 착한 사람이었고, 성령과 믿음이 가득한 사람이었다.
ko.R: 바나바는 그곳에 가서 하나님의 은혜가 이 사람들에게 하신 일을 보았다. 그는 몹시 기뻐했다. 그리고 그들 모두에게 계속 이렇게 말했다. "마음을 굳게 정하고 주님께 충성하십시오." \v 24 바나바는 착한 사람이었다. 그는 성령이 가득하고 믿음이 가득한 사람이었다.

decisions.choice: the grace of God: God's undeserved kindness, seen in what it had done among the believers
decisions.reason: Barnabas could see the grace of God in the changed lives of the new believers. Luke ties grace and gladness together; the two words share a root in the Greek.

decisions.choice: was exhorting: kept urging and encouraging
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to urge, to encourage or to comfort. Barnabas's name was explained as "son of encouragement" (4:36), from a word of the same family.

decisions.choice: with purpose of heart: with firm resolve
alternatives: with the purpose that was in Barnabas's heart
decisions.reason: The phrase most naturally describes how the believers are to remain: wholeheartedly and by firm decision.

decisions.choice: for he was a good man: the reason Barnabas acted as he did
alternatives: the reason the church sent him
decisions.reason: "For" explains what came before: his gladness and encouragement came from his character and from the Spirit.

decisions.choice: what God's grace had done
decisions.reason: Readable says how grace can be seen.

decisions.choice: his urging as direct speech
alternatives: he urged them to remain with the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable turns his words into a short quotation to keep the sentences simple.

decisions.choice: "은혜" for charis; "권하다" (L, B) for parakaleō, which answers his name, "격려의 아들" (4:36); Barnabas speaks to them in 합쇼체 (R)
decisions.reason: God's undeserved kindness, seen in what it had done (meaning decision), with the key term. Readable gives his urging as direct speech, as the English Readable does, in the style of a leader speaking to a gathering.

source.text: καὶ προσετέθη ὄχλος ἱκανὸς τῷ κυρίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: And was added a crowd considerable to the Lord.

en.L: And a considerable crowd was added to the Lord.
en.B: And a sizable crowd was added to the Lord.
en.R: Many more people became followers of the Lord.

es.L: Y fue añadida al Señor una multitud considerable.
es.B: Y un buen número de personas fue sumado al Señor.
es.R: Muchas personas más se hicieron seguidoras del Señor.

fr.L: Et une foule considérable fut ajoutée au Seigneur.
fr.B: Et une foule nombreuse fut ainsi gagnée au Seigneur.
fr.R: Beaucoup d’autres gens ont commencé à suivre le Seigneur.

sw.L: Na umati wa kutosha uliongezwa kwa Bwana.
sw.B: Hivyo kundi kubwa la watu liliongezwa kwa Bwana.
sw.R: Watu wengi zaidi wakawa wafuasi wa Bwana.

vi.L: Và có rất đông người được thêm vào cho Chúa.
vi.B: Và có thêm rất đông người theo Chúa.
vi.R: Có thêm rất nhiều người nữa trở thành môn đồ của Chúa.

ko.L: 그리고 상당히 많은 무리가 주님께 더해졌다.
ko.B: 그래서 많은 사람이 주님께로 더해졌다.
ko.R: 더 많은 사람이 주님을 따르게 되었다.

decisions.choice: was added: God added them
decisions.reason: The passive leaves the one adding unnamed; in 2:47 it is the Lord who adds to their number.

decisions.choice: to the Lord: they were joined to the Lord himself, not only to a group
decisions.reason: Luke says the same in 5:14.

decisions.choice: became followers of the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable says what being added to the Lord meant.

decisions.choice: "được thêm vào cho Chúa" (L)
decisions.reason: They were joined to the Lord himself, not only to a group (meaning decision); Literal keeps "to the Lord".

source.text: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ εἰς Ταρσὸν ἀναζητῆσαι Σαῦλον, καὶ εὑρὼν ἤγαγεν εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν.

records.literal_gloss: He went out then to Tarsus to seek Saul, \v 26 and having found [him] he brought [him] to Antioch.

en.L: Then he went out to Tarsus to look for Saul, \v 26 and having found [him], he brought [him] to Antioch.
en.B: Barnabas then set out for Tarsus to search for Saul, \v 26 and when he had found him he brought him to Antioch.
en.R: Then Barnabas went to the city of Tarsus to look for Saul. \v 26 When he found him, he brought him to Antioch.

es.L: Y salió hacia Tarso a buscar a Saulo, \v 26 y cuando [lo] encontró, [lo] llevó a Antioquía.
es.B: Después Bernabé partió hacia Tarso a buscar a Saulo, \v 26 y cuando lo encontró, lo llevó a Antioquía.
es.R: Luego Bernabé fue a la ciudad de Tarso para buscar a Saulo. \v 26 Cuando lo encontró, lo llevó a Antioquía.

fr.L: Puis il partit pour Tarse chercher Saul, \v 26 et, [l’]ayant trouvé, il [l’]amena à Antioche.
fr.B: Barnabas partit ensuite pour Tarse à la recherche de Saul, \v 26 et, quand il l’eut trouvé, il l’amena à Antioche.
fr.R: Ensuite, Barnabas est allé dans la ville de Tarse pour chercher Saul. \v 26 Quand il l’a trouvé, il l’a amené à Antioche.

sw.L: Kisha alitoka kwenda Tarso kumtafuta Sauli, \v 26 na alipomwona alimleta Antiokia.
sw.B: Kisha Barnaba alikwenda Tarso kumtafuta Sauli, \v 26 na alipomwona, akamleta Antiokia.
sw.R: Kisha Barnaba alikwenda mji wa Tarso kumtafuta Sauli. \v 26 Alipomwona, alimleta Antiokia.

vi.L: Rồi ông đi đến Tạt-sơ để tìm Sau-lơ, \v 26 tìm được rồi thì đưa về An-ti-ốt.
vi.B: Sau đó Ba-na-ba đi đến Tạt-sơ để tìm Sau-lơ, \v 26 và khi tìm được, ông đưa Sau-lơ về An-ti-ốt.
vi.R: Sau đó Ba-na-ba đi đến thành Tạt-sơ để tìm Sau-lơ. \v 26 Khi tìm được Sau-lơ, ông đưa Sau-lơ về An-ti-ốt.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 사울을 찾으려고 다소로 가서, \v 26 그를 만나 안디옥으로 데려왔다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 바나바는 사울을 찾으려고 다소로 갔다. \v 26 그리고 그를 만나서 안디옥으로 데리고 왔다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 바나바는 사울을 찾으러 다소라는 도시로 갔다. \v 26 바나바는 사울을 만나서 안디옥으로 데려왔다.

decisions.choice: Tarsus: Saul's home city in Cilicia, where the believers had sent him
decisions.reason: Saul came from Tarsus (9:11, 21:39), and the believers sent him there when his life was in danger in Jerusalem (9:30). Tarsus lies by sea and road some distance to the northwest of Antioch.

decisions.choice: to look for: to search him out
decisions.reason: The verb suggests searching with some effort; he had to find him.

decisions.choice: Barnabas
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name him, since Saul is named in the same sentence.

source.text: ἐγένετο δὲ αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐνιαυτὸν ὅλον συναχθῆναι ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ διδάξαι ὄχλον ἱκανόν, χρηματίσαι τε πρώτως ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ τοὺς μαθητὰς Χριστιανούς.

records.literal_gloss: It happened now to them also a year whole to be gathered together in the church and to teach a crowd considerable, to be called then first in Antioch the disciples Christians.

en.L: And it happened to them that for a whole year they met with the church and taught a considerable crowd, and the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
en.B: For an entire year the two of them took part in the church's gatherings and taught a sizable crowd. It was in Antioch that the disciples first came to be called Christians.
en.R: For a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the believers there and taught many people. Antioch was the first place where the followers of Jesus were called Christians.

es.L: Y les aconteció que durante un año entero se reunieron con la iglesia y enseñaron a una multitud considerable, y que en Antioquía los discípulos fueron llamados por primera vez cristianos.
es.B: Durante todo un año, los dos participaron en las reuniones de la iglesia y enseñaron a mucha gente. Fue en Antioquía donde los discípulos comenzaron a ser conocidos como cristianos.
es.R: Durante un año entero, Bernabé y Saulo se reunieron con los creyentes de allí y enseñaron a mucha gente. Antioquía fue el primer lugar donde a los discípulos de Jesús los llamaron cristianos.

fr.L: Et il leur arriva, pendant une année entière, de se réunir dans l’église et d’enseigner une foule considérable, et ce fut à Antioche que, pour la première fois, les disciples furent appelés chrétiens.
fr.B: Pendant une année entière, tous deux prirent part aux assemblées de l’église et enseignèrent une foule nombreuse. C’est à Antioche que, pour la première fois, les disciples reçurent le nom de chrétiens.
fr.R: Pendant toute une année, Barnabas et Saul se sont réunis avec les croyants de cette ville, et ils ont enseigné beaucoup de gens. Antioche est le premier endroit où l’on a appelé chrétiens ceux qui suivaient Jésus.

sw.L: Ikawa kwao hata kwa mwaka mzima kukusanyika katika kanisa na kufundisha umati wa kutosha, na kwamba kwanza katika Antiokia wanafunzi walipewa jina la Wakristo.
sw.B: Kwa muda wa mwaka mzima wawili hao walishiriki mikutano ya kanisa na kufundisha kundi kubwa la watu. Ni huko Antiokia ambapo wanafunzi walianza kujulikana kwa jina la Wakristo.
sw.R: Kwa mwaka mzima Barnaba na Sauli walikutana na waumini wa huko na kuwafundisha watu wengi. Antiokia ndipo mahali pa kwanza ambapo wanafunzi wa Yesu waliitwa Wakristo.

vi.L: Trọn một năm, hai ông nhóm họp với Hội Thánh và dạy dỗ khá đông người; và tại An-ti-ốt, lần đầu tiên các môn đồ được gọi là Cơ Đốc nhân.
vi.B: Suốt cả một năm, hai ông tham dự các buổi nhóm của Hội Thánh và dạy dỗ khá đông người. Chính tại An-ti-ốt mà các môn đồ được gọi là Cơ Đốc nhân lần đầu tiên.
vi.R: Suốt một năm, Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ nhóm lại với các tín hữu ở đó và dạy dỗ rất nhiều người. An-ti-ốt là nơi đầu tiên các môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu được gọi là Cơ Đốc nhân.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 꼬박 한 해 동안 교회에 모여 상당히 많은 무리를 가르쳤다. 그리고 제자들이 안디옥에서 처음으로 그리스도인이라고 불렸다.
ko.B: 두 사람은 한 해 동안 꼬박 교회 모임에 함께하며 많은 사람을 가르쳤다. 그리고 제자들이 처음으로 그리스도인이라고 불린 것이 안디옥에서였다.
ko.R: 바나바와 사울은 한 해 동안 그곳의 믿는 사람들과 함께 모이며 많은 사람을 가르쳤다. 예수의 제자들이 처음으로 그리스도인이라고 불린 곳이 바로 안디옥이었다.

decisions.choice: Christians: those who belong to the Christ, a name formed from the title
alternatives: a name the believers gave themselves
decisions.reason: The name is made from the word for the Christ with an ending that marks someone's followers or party, like "Herodians" for Herod's supporters (Mark 3:6). It appears only here, in 26:28, on the lips of King Agrippa, and in 1 Peter 4:16, where it is a charge against believers. So it was most likely given by outsiders who saw that these people belonged to the Christ. Luke does not say who first used it.

decisions.choice: were called: were known by this name
decisions.reason: The verb is used of bearing a name (Romans 7:3). It does not say who named them.

decisions.choice: they met with the church: they took part in its gatherings
decisions.reason: The passive verb with "in the church" means they joined its meetings, where they taught.

decisions.choice: Christians at every level, with no reader setting
alternatives: a span that switches with the christos setting
decisions.reason: The christos setting chooses between Christ and Messiah where the title itself stands. Here the word is a name that the believers were given and still bear, and it has no settled form built on "Messiah". So every level keeps "Christians", and the meaning note explains how the name was formed.

decisions.choice: the two of them; Barnabas and Saul
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "they" were.

decisions.choice: the believers; the followers of Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words for the church and the disciples.

decisions.choice: discípulos (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "the followers of Jesus". The term sheet keeps "discípulos" at every level, a word every Spanish reader knows; the same in verse 29.

decisions.choice: cristianos, with no christos span
decisions.reason: As in the English, "cristianos" is the name the disciples were given (meaning decision m1), not the title itself, so it stays the same under either christos setting.

decisions.choice: chrétiens (lower case), with no reader setting
decisions.reason: As the English, the name takes no christos setting. French writes the name of the followers of a religion with a lower-case letter ("les chrétiens"), as it does "les juifs" for believers in Judaism; a capital would read as the name of a people.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "the followers of Jesus". The term sheet keeps "wanafunzi" at every level, the everyday word for a teacher's disciples; the same in verse 29.

decisions.choice: Wakristo, with no christos span
decisions.reason: As in the English, "Wakristo" is the name the disciples were given (meaning decision m1), not the title itself, so it stays the same under either christos setting.

decisions.choice: "Cơ Đốc nhân" for Christians at every level, with no christos span
decisions.reason: Those who belong to the Christ, a name formed from the title (meaning decision). "Cơ Đốc" is the old Vietnamese rendering of "Christ", and "Cơ Đốc nhân" is the word of the Vietnamese 1 Peter 4:16; as in English, the name is not under the setting.

decisions.choice: "그리스도인" at every level, with no christos span
decisions.reason: Christians are those who belong to the Christ, a name formed from the title (meaning decision). The English has no reader setting here, so the Korean has none either: "그리스도인" is the name the church still bears, and "기독교인" is the alternative from the Chinese form of the name.

source.text: Ἐν ταύταις δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις κατῆλθον ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων προφῆται εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν·

records.literal_gloss: In these now the days came down from Jerusalem prophets to Antioch.

en.L: Now in these days prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
en.B: About that time prophets came down to Antioch from Jerusalem.
en.R: During that time some prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.

es.L: Y en estos días bajaron profetas de Jerusalén a Antioquía.
es.B: Por esas fechas llegaron a Antioquía unos profetas que venían de Jerusalén.
es.R: En ese tiempo, algunos profetas fueron de Jerusalén a Antioquía.

fr.L: Or en ces jours-là, des prophètes descendirent de Jérusalem à Antioche.
fr.B: Vers cette époque, des prophètes descendirent de Jérusalem à Antioche.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, des prophètes sont venus de Jérusalem à Antioche.

sw.L: Na katika siku hizi manabii walishuka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Antiokia.
sw.B: Wakati huo manabii kadhaa walishuka kutoka Yerusalemu wakaja Antiokia.
sw.R: Wakati huo baadhi ya manabii walikwenda Antiokia kutoka Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy, có mấy nhà tiên tri từ Giê-ru-sa-lem xuống An-ti-ốt.
vi.B: Trong thời gian ấy, có mấy nhà tiên tri từ Giê-ru-sa-lem xuống An-ti-ốt.
vi.R: Trong thời gian ấy, có mấy nhà tiên tri từ Giê-ru-sa-lem đến An-ti-ốt.

ko.L: 그런데 이 무렵 예언자들이 예루살렘에서 안디옥으로 내려왔다.
ko.B: 그 무렵 예언자 몇 사람이 예루살렘에서 안디옥으로 내려왔다.
ko.R: 그 무렵 몇몇 예언자가 예루살렘에서 안디옥으로 왔다.

decisions.choice: prophets: believers who spoke messages from God by the Spirit
alternatives: the prophets of the Old Testament
decisions.reason: Peter said at Pentecost that God's people would prophesy (2:17-18). The church at Antioch had prophets of its own (13:1), and Agabus is met again in 21:10-11.

decisions.choice: came down: traveled from Jerusalem, which stands high in the hills
decisions.reason: People went up to Jerusalem and came down from it, whichever way they traveled.

decisions.choice: "nhà tiên tri" for the prophets among the believers
decisions.reason: Believers who spoke messages from God by the Spirit (meaning decision), called by the same word as the prophets of old.

source.text: ἀναστὰς δὲ εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν ὀνόματι Ἅγαβος ἐσήμανεν διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος λιμὸν μεγάλην μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν οἰκουμένην· ἥτις ἐγένετο ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου.

records.literal_gloss: Having stood up then one of them by name Agabus signified through the Spirit a famine great to be about to be over all the inhabited world, which happened under Claudius.

en.L: And one of them named Agabus stood up and signified through the Spirit that a great famine was about to come over all the inhabited world, which happened under Claudius.
en.B: Agabus, one of them, rose and, by the Spirit, foretold a great famine that would come on the whole world. And it came, in the days of the emperor Claudius.
en.R: One of them was named Agabus. He stood up and spoke a message from the Holy Spirit. He said that a terrible time of hunger would soon come over the whole world. It did happen later, when Claudius was the Roman emperor.

es.L: Y levantándose uno de ellos, llamado Agabo, daba a entender por medio del Espíritu que iba a haber una gran hambruna sobre toda la tierra habitada, la cual sucedió en tiempos de Claudio.
es.B: Uno de ellos, llamado Agabo, se puso de pie y, movido por el Espíritu, anunció que vendría una gran hambruna sobre todo el mundo. Y así ocurrió en tiempos del emperador Claudio.
es.R: Uno de ellos se llamaba Agabo. Se puso de pie y dio un mensaje del Espíritu Santo. Dijo que pronto habría un tiempo de mucha hambre en todo el mundo. Y así pasó después, cuando Claudio era el emperador romano.

fr.L: Et l’un d’eux, du nom d’Agabus, s’étant levé, annonça par l’Esprit qu’une grande famine allait survenir sur toute la terre habitée ; elle arriva sous Claude.
fr.B: L’un d’eux, Agabus, se leva et annonça par l’Esprit une grande famine qui allait frapper le monde entier. Elle arriva en effet au temps de l’empereur Claude.
fr.R: L’un d’eux s’appelait Agabus. Il s’est levé et il a donné un message de l’Esprit Saint. Il a dit qu’une terrible période de faim allait bientôt arriver dans le monde entier. C’est bien ce qui s’est passé plus tard, quand Claude était l’empereur romain.

sw.L: Na mmoja wao, aitwaye Agabo, akisimama, aliashiria kupitia Roho kwamba njaa kubwa ingekuja juu ya ulimwengu wote unaokaliwa; nayo ilitokea chini ya Klaudio.
sw.B: Mmoja wao, aitwaye Agabo, alisimama, na kwa uongozi wa Roho akatabiri kwamba njaa kubwa ingeupata ulimwengu wote. Njaa hiyo ilikuja kweli katika siku za utawala wa Kaisari Klaudio.
sw.R: Mmoja wao aliitwa Agabo. Alisimama, akasema ujumbe kutoka kwa Roho Mtakatifu. Alisema kwamba wakati wa njaa kali ungekuja hivi karibuni katika dunia nzima. Na kweli ilitokea baadaye, wakati Klaudio alipokuwa mtawala wa Dola ya Kirumi.

vi.L: Một người trong số họ tên là A-ga-bút đứng dậy, nhờ Thánh Linh báo trước rằng sẽ có nạn đói lớn trên khắp thế giới; nạn đói ấy đã xảy ra dưới thời Cơ-lốt.
vi.B: Một người trong số họ tên là A-ga-bút đứng dậy, nhờ Thánh Linh báo trước rằng sẽ có nạn đói lớn xảy ra khắp thế giới. Nạn đói ấy đã xảy ra vào thời hoàng đế Cơ-lốt.
vi.R: Một người trong số họ tên là A-ga-bút. Ông đứng dậy và nói một sứ điệp từ Đức Thánh Linh. Ông nói rằng sắp có một nạn đói khủng khiếp trên khắp thế giới. Việc ấy đã xảy ra sau này, khi Cơ-lốt làm hoàng đế La Mã.

ko.L: 그런데 그들 가운데 아가보라는 사람이 일어나서, 온 세상에 큰 흉년이 들 것이라고 성령으로 알려 주었다. 그 흉년은 글라우디오 때에 들었다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 아가보라는 사람이 일어나서, 온 세상에 큰 흉년이 들 것이라고 성령의 감동으로 예언했다. 그 흉년은 글라우디오 황제 때에 들었다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 아가보라는 사람이 있었다. 그는 일어나서 성령께서 주신 말씀을 전했다. 그는 온 세상에 곧 먹을 것이 몹시 모자라는 끔찍한 때가 올 것이라고 말했다. 그 일은 나중에 글라우디오가 로마 황제였을 때 일어났다.

decisions.choice: the inhabited world: the lands under Rome, the world as people of the time knew it
decisions.reason: The same word is used of the census of "all the world" under Augustus (Luke 2:1). It need not mean every land at once.

decisions.choice: which happened under Claudius: Claudius was emperor from AD 41 to 54, and food was short in several places in his reign
alternatives: a single famine everywhere at once
decisions.reason: The Roman writer Suetonius speaks of repeated food shortages in Claudius's reign (Claudius 18). Josephus tells of a severe famine in Judea in the governorship of Tiberius Alexander, about AD 46-48, when Queen Helena of Adiabene bought grain in Egypt for the people of Jerusalem (Antiquities 20.51-53, 20.101).

decisions.choice: signified through the Spirit: told beforehand by the Spirit's prompting
alternatives: used a sign or acted it out
decisions.reason: The verb means to make known, often what is to come (John 12:33). In 21:11 Agabus acts out a prophecy, but here only his words are reported.

decisions.choice: a terrible time of hunger
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word.

decisions.choice: emperor; the Roman emperor
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who Claudius was.

decisions.choice: Kaisari Klaudio (B); mtawala wa Dola ya Kirumi (R)
decisions.reason: The English supplies "emperor" (meaning decision m2). "Kaisari" is the title Swahili readers know from the Gospels; "mfalme" would make him one king among others. Readable says what his rule was.

decisions.choice: "A-ga-bút", "Cơ-lốt"; "thế giới" for the inhabited world
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names; "thế giới" as in the Vietnamese Luke 4:5 for "oikoumenē".

decisions.choice: "아가보", "글라우디오"; "온 세상" for oikoumenē
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names (style guide, Settled); "황제" (B, R) as the English adds "emperor". The inhabited world is the world as people of the time knew it (meaning decision), which "온 세상" says.

source.text: τῶν δὲ μαθητῶν καθὼς εὐπορεῖτό τις ὥρισαν ἕκαστος αὐτῶν εἰς διακονίαν πέμψαι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ἀδελφοῖς·

records.literal_gloss: Of the now disciples, as was prospering anyone, determined each of them for service to send to the dwelling in the Judea brothers;

en.L: And the disciples, as anyone was able, each of them determined to send [something] for relief to the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} living in Judea,
en.B: The disciples resolved that each of them would send something, as much as each could afford, as relief for the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} living in Judea.
en.R: The followers of Jesus in Antioch decided to help the believers who lived in Judea. Each of them would give as much as they could.

es.L: Y los discípulos, según cada uno tenía medios, determinaron, cada uno de ellos, enviar [algo] como ayuda a los hermanos que vivían en Judea,
es.B: Los discípulos decidieron que cada uno, según sus posibilidades, enviaría algo como ayuda para los hermanos que vivían en Judea.
es.R: Los discípulos de Antioquía decidieron ayudar a los creyentes que vivían en Judea. Cada uno daría todo lo que pudiera.

fr.L: Et, parmi les disciples, selon les moyens de chacun, ils décidèrent, chacun d’eux, d’envoyer [une aide] en service aux {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui habitaient en Judée,
fr.B: Les disciples décidèrent que chacun, selon ses moyens, enverrait une aide aux {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui vivaient en Judée.
fr.R: Les disciples de Jésus à Antioche ont décidé d’aider les croyants qui vivaient en Judée. Chacun allait donner autant qu’il pouvait.

sw.L: Na kati ya wanafunzi, kila mtu kulingana na uwezo aliokuwa nao, waliamua kila mmoja wao kutuma [kitu] kama huduma kwa ndugu wanaoishi Uyahudi,
sw.B: Wanafunzi waliamua kwamba kila mmoja wao, kwa kadiri ya uwezo wake, atatuma msaada kwa ajili ya ndugu walioishi Uyahudi.
sw.R: Wanafunzi wa Antiokia waliamua kuwasaidia waumini walioishi Uyahudi. Kila mmoja angetoa kadiri alivyoweza.

vi.L: Các môn đồ, tùy theo khả năng của mỗi người, quyết định gửi đồ cứu trợ cho các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} sống tại Giu-đê;
vi.B: Các môn đồ quyết định mỗi người tùy khả năng mình gửi một ít đồ cứu trợ cho các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} sống tại Giu-đê.
vi.R: Các môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu ở An-ti-ốt quyết định giúp đỡ các tín hữu sống ở miền Giu-đê. Mỗi người sẽ góp tùy theo khả năng của mình.

ko.L: 그래서 제자들은 각자 형편이 되는 대로 유대에 사는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 구호품을 보내기로 작정했다.
ko.B: 그래서 제자들은 저마다 힘닿는 대로 유대에 사는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들을 돕기 위하여 구호금을 보내기로 했다.
ko.R: 안디옥에 있는 예수의 제자들은 유대에 사는 믿는 사람들을 돕기로 했다. 저마다 할 수 있는 만큼 돈을 내기로 했다.

decisions.choice: service: help sent for those in need
decisions.reason: The word means service. Here, as in 12:25, it is the gift carried to Judea; Paul uses it in the same way for later collections (Romans 15:31; 2 Corinthians 8:4).

decisions.choice: as anyone was able: each gave according to what they had
decisions.reason: The verb means to have plenty, to prosper. Each person's gift matched their means, as Paul later teaches (1 Corinthians 16:2).

decisions.choice: brothers: the believers in Judea, men and women
decisions.reason: The gift was for the whole community of believers in Judea.

decisions.choice: brothers and sisters, with "brothers" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: the followers of Jesus in Antioch; the believers
decisions.reason: Readable says who the disciples and the brothers were.

source.text: ὃ καὶ ἐποίησαν ἀποστείλαντες πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους διὰ χειρὸς Βαρναβᾶ καὶ Σαύλου.

records.literal_gloss: which also they did, having sent [it] to the elders by [the] hand of Barnabas and Saul.

en.L: which they also did, sending [it] to the elders by [the] hand of Barnabas and Saul.
en.B: And they carried it out, sending it to the elders in the care of Barnabas and Saul.
en.R: And they did it. They gave the money to Barnabas and Saul, and those two took it to the leaders of the church in Judea.

es.L: cosa que también hicieron, enviando [la ayuda] a los ancianos por mano de Bernabé y de Saulo.
es.B: Y así lo hicieron: enviaron la ayuda a los ancianos por medio de Bernabé y Saulo.
es.R: Y lo hicieron. Le dieron el dinero a Bernabé y a Saulo, y ellos dos se lo llevaron a los líderes de la iglesia en Judea.

fr.L: ce qu’ils firent aussi, en [l’]envoyant aux anciens par la main de Barnabas et de Saul.
fr.B: C’est ce qu’ils firent : ils envoyèrent l’aide aux anciens par l’intermédiaire de Barnabas et de Saul.
fr.R: Et c’est ce qu’ils ont fait. Ils ont donné l’argent à Barnabas et à Saul, et ces deux hommes l’ont apporté aux responsables des églises de Judée.

sw.L: jambo ambalo walilifanya pia, wakiipeleka kwa wazee kwa mkono wa Barnaba na Sauli.
sw.B: Nao walifanya hivyo, wakaupeleka msaada huo kwa wazee mikononi mwa Barnaba na Sauli.
sw.R: Nao walifanya hivyo. Waliwapa Barnaba na Sauli fedha hizo, nao wawili wakazipeleka kwa viongozi wa kanisa huko Uyahudi.

vi.L: và họ đã làm như vậy, nhờ tay Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ gửi đến các trưởng lão.
vi.B: Họ đã làm như vậy, gửi đồ cứu trợ đến các trưởng lão qua tay Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ.
vi.R: Và họ đã làm như vậy. Họ giao tiền cho Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ, và hai ông đem đến cho các trưởng lão, là những người lãnh đạo Hội Thánh ở Giu-đê.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그렇게 하여, 바나바와 사울의 손으로 장로들에게 보냈다.
ko.B: 그들은 그대로 하여, 바나바와 사울 편에 장로들에게 그것을 보냈다.
ko.R: 그들은 그렇게 했다. 그들은 그 돈을 바나바와 사울에게 맡겼다. 그리고 두 사람은 그 돈을 유대에 있는 교회 지도자들에게 가져갔다.

decisions.choice: the elders: leaders of the believers in Judea
alternatives: the elders of the Jewish council
decisions.reason: This is the first mention of elders among the believers. Jewish communities had elders, and the churches did too (14:23, 15:2, 15:6, 20:17). In 15:4-6 the elders lead the church in Jerusalem alongside the apostles.

decisions.choice: by the hand of: through, carried by
alternatives: handed over in person to each elder
decisions.reason: A common Hebrew way of saying "through"; Barnabas and Saul took the gift.

decisions.choice: which they also did: they carried out what they had decided
alternatives: they did it later, after the famine
decisions.reason: Luke does not say exactly when the gift was sent; 12:25 tells of the end of the errand.

decisions.choice: the money; the leaders of the church in Judea
decisions.reason: Readable says what was sent and who the elders were. The text does not say whether it was money or food; money is the likelier gift for a long journey.

decisions.choice: los ancianos (L, B); los líderes de la iglesia (R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet words for the church office, recorded once in this chapter: the leaders of the believers in Judea (meaning decision m1). Readable says what they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: wazee (L, B); viongozi wa kanisa (R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet words for the church office, recorded once in this chapter: the leaders of the believers in Judea (meaning decision m1). Readable says what they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "các trưởng lão" at every level for the elders of the church, with "những người lãnh đạo Hội Thánh" added at Readable (also 14:23)
decisions.reason: Leaders of the believers (meaning decision). The Vietnamese James 5:14 and 1 Timothy give "những người lãnh đạo Hội Thánh" at Readable; here Readable keeps the title too and explains it, as the English Readable does in 14:23.

decisions.choice: "장로들" (L, B); "교회 지도자들" (R) for the church elders, through Acts
decisions.reason: The elders are leaders of the believers in Judea (meaning decision); "장로" is the established word, which Readable says plainly, as in the Korean James 5:14 and Titus 1:5.
